As all cops are required to work with a robot, Kennex must overcome his aversion to androids and get accustomed to his new partner: a discontinued android with unexpected emotional responses.
A dying teenager's last chance for survival rests in torturing a secretive family of scientists for a cure to the disease they created.

title.de: Australien - Eine Jugend zwischen Baum und Borke

overview.en: The powerful story of 10 year old Dujuan and his family, as they struggle to balance his traditional Arrernte/Garrwa upbringing with a Western-style education.
In a violent world, a peace-loving man is forced on a desperate journey to find life-saving drugs for his wife but must first help an ornery old man defend his cabin against nefarious forces.

The classroom is a bar. The grammar teacher is a ghost. The lessons are about pickup lines and put-downs. Chris, Kyle, and the gang from "The Benza" are all back to help Kaori and friends teach English in the comedy spin-off series "Benza English!"
A Bible study turns deadly in this true story of the Halstead murder case, along with other encounters with angels, spirits, and the supernatural.

Experience an action-packed urban mountain bike adventure with extreme sports athlete Fabio Wibmer. Why does he keep pushing his limits and expose himself to high risks of injury? Find out what's going on in his mind and witness how they conquer the craziest urban spots in France - including security & police, as well as spectacular crahses. His videos have millions of clicks but is it really worth the risk? The documentary features daring stunts that are not intended to be imitated.
Based on true events, this full-contact action drama, loaded with authentic mixed martial arts, is a transcending inspirational story of redemption.
Years after a local girl's unsolved murder, a professor returns home to visit his priest brother as a new string of killings rattles the community.
Success goes to the head of a cocky boxing champ, who risks losing the love of his girlfriend, until a life-changing choice slams him down to reality.
Leaving behind a world of addiction, a young man follows in his mother’s footsteps as she prepares him for a life in the culinary arts.
Sample the bold new flavors of France with chefs who are pushing the boundaries of fine dining and reinventing a rich culinary tradition.

Paris. A choir master is found mysteriously murdered in a church, with his eardrums blown out. Police Commander Lionel Kasdan investigates the homicide alongside Interpol Captain Frank Salek, a short-tempered younger cop.
Five LatinX and Black teenagers from the toughest and most underserved ghetto in Miami fight their way into 1998's National Chess Championship.
A cyborg on a quest to cure the world of a plague with a vaccine is captured by cannibals who plot to steal the antidote and rule the world.
While attempting to pick up a woman at a bar, a man weaves a tale involving spies, microchips, and a dangerous military scientist pursuing him.

Małgorzata Szumowska's provocative, adults-only drama stars Academy Award-winner Juliette Binoche as a journalist whose personal life choices are put to the test when she uncovers some discomforting home truths.
Inspired by the true story of speed chess player Genesis Potini whose bipolar disorder resets his life as a teacher of the game to disadvantaged kids.
Rock Hudson portrays an American Army officer who joins forces with his Italian rescuers after they save him from a German attack in this suspenseful WWII drama that co-stars Sylva Koscina.
When a rampage of bloody violence claims his wife’s life, Akira is forced to shed his quiet persona and reveal his lethal dark side.
After 200 years in hiding, Elfie and the Elfkins learn to bake and help Chef Theo save his bakery, reviving their tradition of aiding humans.

title.de: Dissidence. Deux ombres sur le mur
title.en: Dissidence - Two Shadows on the Wall

overview.en: During rehearsals performing "St. Matthew Passion," artists and musicians discuss Johann Sebastian Bach's timeless work and its impact on the audience.
This documentary profiles the Veterans Airlift Command, a volunteer group whose pilots fly former soldiers across the US for treatment.
As a result of a chain of tragic accidents, an astronaut finds himself alone on Mars. His only chance of survival is if Earth launches a rescue mission.

title.de: Fußball vom anderen Stern - Die Geschichte von Cosmos New York
title.en: Once in a Lifetime: The Extraordinary Story of the New York Cosmos

overview.en: When the world's most celebrated soccer star, the Brazilian champion Pele, signed with the N.Y. Cosmos in 1975, the once ignored North American Soccer League became a hit with both fans and the media. The players—including Pele—became the toast of the town, earning their own private table at Studio 54.

Jack (John Lynch), a model prisoner, has kept his head down and done his time. After his wife leaves him on the anniversary of their son's death, the only thing that keeps him from going under is the presence of a new prisoner, Paul (Martin Compston). But when Paul falls under the influence of psychotic "Baron" Clay (Craig Parkinson), Jack soon finds he must risk his own life and sanity to help the newcomer. But can he save both himself and Paul in the process? A hard-hitting, gritty prison drama starring a stellar cast of home-grown British talent and in your face violence, Ghosted is a tough and powerful tale of loss, survival, salvation and life in a British prison.
When chemical warfare leaves the world filled with mutated monsters, survivors must battle a creature that managed to enter their underground bunker.

On the front-line of the emergency in Belgium's hospitals, as the numbers of dead rise and Erasmus hospital struggles to cope, this documentary portrays the healthcare workers at the epicentre of the crisis with unprecedented cinematic quality and deep, crafted storytelling. In the midst the crisis, their struggle with the unfolding nightmare is laid bare with outstanding intimacy.

The 'Ultra' fans of Istanbul's three biggest soccer clubs are known for their passionate rivalries. Yet after protests in 2012 led to a movement against the AK Party, something remarkable happened: the die-hard fans began fighting side-by-side to protect civilians from police, as 'Istanbul United'. With extraordinary footage from right in the fray, this is a rare insight to a powerful subculture.

overview.de: James Bond (Sean Connery) soll den Sowjets in Istanbul eine Dechiffriermaschine abjagen - und kämpft im Orientexpress um sein Leben.
overview.en: Sean Connery returns as James Bond in this thrill-a-minute adventure featuring remarkable villains, beautiful women and exotic locales! This time, Bond squares off against the evil SPECTRE organization in a race to seize a Soviet decoding machine, thrusting him into a thrilling boat chase, a brutal helicopter attack and a deadly brawl aboard the Orient Express.
Un joven pandillero cambia su vida en prisión gracias a la amistad que forma con un asesino condenado, quien termina convirtiéndose en su mentor.
The lives of an emerging superstar and a filmmaker intertwine in this intimate documentary series charting Kanye West's career, filmed over two decades.
An ex-con, who is the unlikeliest of role models, meets a 15-year-old boy and is faced with the choice of redemption or ruin.

title.de: Kidnapped - Die Entführung des Reagan Pearce

overview.en: Former Hollywood star is kidnapped by two men connected to his past while on location in Louisiana. When he wakes up bound and chained in a rundown shack, he soon discovers the real motives of his captors and finds himself in the middle of a twisted scheme with little chance to survive.  With no rescue in sight, he must use every ounce of strength he has left to break free and get his revenge.

title.de: Kuroko’s Basketball - Winter Cup Highlights Movie 1 Shadow and Light
title.en: Kuroko's Basketball - Movie: Winter Cup - Shadow and Light

overview.en: The first match of Seirin vs Tôô Gakuen at the Winter Cup. Seirin swore they would get revenge from the Inter-High, but Aomine's talents grew even stronger and Kuroko's new move is seen through. After having all of his efforts denied by his former light, Aomine, Kuroko is benched and faces humiliation. Seeing his partner like this, something almost beast-like awakens within Kagami, and he cha...

overview.de: Drama nach Tatsachen mit Colin Firth: Im August 2000 sinkt das U-Boot Kursk, 23 Überlebende sind am Grund der Barentssee gefangen. Die russische Regierung lehnt internationale Hilfe ab.
overview.en: The true story of how sailors fought to survive after their Russian submarine sank to the bottom of the Barents Sea, and the government's reaction.
Upon arriving in Hong Kong, an American woman is beaten up and mugged by thugs. She's taken in by a martial arts master who trains her into a fighter.

title.de: LEGO Jurassic World: Die neue Attraktion
title.en: LEGO Jurassic World: The Secret Exhibit

overview.en: In an animated LEGO prequel adventure, Jurassic World's soon-to-be top employees, Owen and Claire, team up to move a trio of dinosaurs across the island for the grand opening of a new, super-secret exhibit.

A group of old friends Ray (Bob Hoskins), Lenny (David Hemmings) and Vic (Tom Courtenay) get together to make a nostalgic journey from London to Margate to scatter the ashes of Jack (Michael Caine), one of their crew. As they make their way in a series of flashbacks they reflect on their friendship with all its secrets, resentments, and deep loyalty.
A solitary broker purchases Kelly, a groundbreaking android with a human-like body. Their cohabitation takes a turn when Kelly mysteriously vanishes.

title.de: LOL: Chi ride è fuori - Halloween Special
title.en: LOL: Chi ride è fuori - Halloween Special

title.de: London: A Tale of Two Cities
title.en: London: A Tale of Two Cities

overview.en: The 17th century saw London plunge into a series of devastating disasters. The Civil War, a murderous plague, and the destruction of the great fire should have all but destroyed the small medieval city, but somehow it not only survived - it thrived.

overview.de: Ein Forschungsteam auf einem Erkundungstauchgang in der Tiefsee muss sich gegen kolossale, prähistorische Haie wehren. Um zu überleben, müssen sie schneller, klüger und gerissener sein.
overview.en: Members of a deep-dive research team fight for their lives against colossal, prehistoric sharks.

Mike is a young man who is a budding street racer, and owner of a Ford Falcon GT-HO Phase III. His best mate and mechanic, Tony, are both steel workers by day, but when they aren't working, they are racing.
In this documentary, outsider artists and tech experts explore the highs and lows of the NFT phenomenon, a volatile intersection of culture and capital.

When his brother is shot and his niece kidnapped, a former MMA champion turned police detective is forced to go back into the ring for one final match to rescue the girl and appease the criminals who have harmed his family.
A bounty hunter with a pregnant wife who is urging him to get a regular job gets framed for murder and trapped in a war between Russian gangsters.
For Lindeman, a struggling 25-year-old art student, life has lost its zip. In order to reinvigorate his work, he forces himself into new situations.

Eco-activist Rod Coronado has made it his life’s mission to advocate for the planet and animal rights. In 2014, he formed Wolf Patrol, an activist group that fights to preserve the grey wolves which roam Wisconsin’s forests. This documentary follows his attempt to end wolf hunting in the U.S.
A documentary that follows a year in the life of a skateboarding sensation as he transforms from a cool street skater to a celebrity sportsperson.
When an alien spacecraft is being sought by various factions on Earth, a cyborg and rogue trader team up to stop them from taking over the ship.
When a pop star finds herself in Purgatory, she sets out with a detective named Jack to find her mother who committed suicide 20 years ago.

title.de: Qatar’s Workers Cup – Die Weltmeisterschaft der Arbeiter

overview.en: Inside Qatar's labor camps, African and Asian migrant workers building the facilities of the 2022 World Cup compete in a football tournament of their own.

In 1981 Queen arrived in Montreal on their record-breaking tour. This concert would be their only one to be filmed. Songs include We Will Rock You, Somebody To Love, Killer Queen, Under Pressure, Crazy Little Thing Called Love, Bohemian Rhapsody, Another One Bites The Dust, Sheer Heart Attack.

title.de: Redwing - Flucht vor den schwarzen Droiden

overview.en: A young woman with a crippling dermatological disease discovers that to correct her complexion she must replace her skin with that of other girls.
Two extreme sports athletes enter a contest for a huge cash price only to discover the “game” is an evil reality show with a frightening ritual.

Christmas Eve is right around the corner, when everything goes haywire. Santa's 92,000 elves all fall ill and collapse... Simultaneously! Santa panics and worries about who will make the toys for all the kids all around the world? He has no choice! Santa and his reindeer must go to Earth in search of a cure. But once he gets there, Mr. Claus will need some help to save the magic of Christmas...
On the surface, Ariel and Greg seem to be the perfect couple. But when Greg goes missing, Ariel’s world is turned upside down and secrets come out.
Mason is a matchmaking with a booming success rate and is an expert on relationships. When it comes to love, he knows all, except how to hold onto his husband.

title.en: She-Ra and the Princesses of Power

overview.en: In this reboot of the 1980s original, a magic sword transforms an orphan girl into warrior She-Ra, who unites a rebellion to fight against evil.
After a motorcycle racer’s brother dies and leaves behind his high-tech prototype bike, he decides to use it to compete in the world championship.
Learn about the life and career of opera star John Treleaven, as his son takes him on a personal and emotional journey down memory lane.
Peering into the kitchens of legendary chefs Eneko Atxa and Jiro Ono, this film explores the deep traditions of Basque and Japanese cuisines.

Freshman high-school student Melinda (Kristen Stewart) has refused to speak ever since she called the cops on a popular summer party. With her old friends snubbing her for being a rat, and her parents (Elizabeth Perkins, D.B. Sweeney) too busy to notice her troubles, she folds into herself, trying to hide her secret: that star senior Andy (Eric Lively) raped her at the party. But Melinda does manage to find solace in her art class headed by Mr. Freeman (Steve Zahn).

In 1979, in Caguas, Puerto Rico, at the initiative of an ambitious and skilled businessman named Edgardo Díaz, a group was born that laid the foundations for the "boy bands" that still exist today. Creating never-before-seen rules and a work style that had never been implemented before, he developed a group that continues to be the benchmark for all other Hispanic youth bands.
All of the delightful residents of Sylvanian Village are always having the best time with their friends and families.

In this gruesome thriller, a burnt body of a woman is found with areas of skin missing. Soon a rookie and veteran cop discover a group of art enthusiasts who covet a series of 12 tattoos by a Japanese artist.
An insane Army major uses a prisoner for a test to invent an invisibility formula to make zombies, while his employee goes invisible as a bank robber.
An experiment blending quantum physics with the occult opens the door to a surreal underground world of monsters and shadow people.
NASA's moon mission challenges and achievements, with expert interviews and stunning footage.
Spirit Of Football uses soccer to promote unity and fight racism.

THE TARGET A movie about how different types of bullying affects different types of people of different ages. Arav deals with bullying in a detrimental way leaving his family and friends bewildered. People find themselves reflecting about their own current bullying experiences.

The Young Sea shows the hidden life and beauty of the few, but amazing species that live in the Baltic Sea. An outstandingly beautiful and unique perspective on the critical situation, looking at how our everyday actions play a critical role in the future condition of one of the worlds' youngest bodies of water.
Kristin and Valerie bond in Himalayan trek, reflecting on friendship before a life change.

Savas Türkyilmaz, aka "Deliormanli", is a professional boxer who holds the European champion title. Deliormanli quits boxing and disappears into thin air after his wife passes away. Savas decides to return to his boxing career. When the path of Deliomanli intersects with Hülya Yigit, a famous anchor woman, they find themselves falling in love with each other.

title.de: Vamizi - Artenreiches Korallenriff vor Ostafrikas Küste

overview.en: In the shimmering waters of the Indian Ocean lies the island of Vamizi, home to one of the world's oldest and most pristine coral reefs. Natural reserves of oil and gas have been discovered below this wonderland of marine biodiversity, and now this vibrant, flourishing reef is a target for energy companies. With one-third of the world's coral reefs dying, this urgent doc follows a team of conservationists in a race against time to save Vamizi.
A family tests whether they can explore South America in a camper without giving up their old life.

The Pup Star family just got bigger! And the new pups: Cindy, Rosie, Charlie and Brody will have to learn the true meaning of Christmas. When Pup Star's Mean Team scheme to ruin Christmas, the pups end up in the North Pole to save Santa and the holiday spirit. Their adventure is filled with new pup-tastic songs to spread holiday cheer all year round.
After losing his job at Christmastime, a man (Robert Urich) decides, to the chagrin of his family, to become a professional golfer.

Yugi Moto solves an Ancient Egyptian Puzzle and brings forth a dark and powerful alter ego. Whenever he and his friends are threatened by evil in Duel Monster Card Game, this alter ego breaks out to save them.

title.en: When Zachary Beaver Came to Town

overview.en: Welcome to Granger, Texas, and into the life of 12 year-old Toby Wilson. This coming of age story finds Toby in the middle of an unforgettable summer in his normally sleepy Texas town.

title.de: Zehn Stunden Zeit für Virgil Tibbs

overview.en: In this classic mystery, Detective Virgil Tibbs battles a puzzling murder of a prostitute in San Francisco in this exciting sequel.

A masterly immersion into life at a Japanese Zen monastery that is both simple and beautifully filmed, director Werner Penzel's documentary follows a young woman as she encounters the philosophy of the Japanese Zen master Kodo Sawaki and the surprises brought forth by everyday monastic life.
This film looks at a zoo closure and a case in which an orangutan was declared a “Non-Human Person,” forever changing the animal rights landscape.

Rocky Is A Bollywood Romantic Hindi Action Movie, Directed By Sunil Dutt, Starring Sanjay Dutt, Reena Roy, Tina Munim, Amjad Khan, Raakhee, Ranjeet, Shakti Kapoor and Aruna Irani In The Lead Roles. Post His Father's Death, Rakesh Is Traumatised And, Thus, Adopted By A Christian Couple Who Rename Him, Rocky. However, He Later Realizes His True Identity And Vows To Avenge His Father's Murder.

title.de: ウチの娘は、彼氏が出来ない!!
エンジェルフライト 国際霊柩送還士

overview.en: Ryoko Yonekura stars in this series written by Ryota Kosawa about specialists who transport the deceased back home. The company Angel Hearse is run by Nami Izawa (Ryoko Yonekura) and Kashiwagi (Kenichi Endo). A drama that portrays love between the deceased and the bereaved. Original story: Angel Flight: International Corpse Repatriator by Ryoko Sasa (Shueisha Bunko)/Produced by: NHK Enterprises

They work for the police, but have no investigative authority! Even so, suspended detective Suzunosuke Shikahama, pacifist administrator Haruhi Mabuchi, blunt public safety officer Sesuna Tsumiki, and imaginative accountant Ruka Kotori all gather for one purpose. They seek the truth using their unconventional methods, even if it that truth turns out to be bigger than anyone expected. ©NIPPON TV

title.de: 地味にスゴイ! 校閲ガール・河野悦子

overview.en: [With ENG Subtitles] Etsuko's lifelong dream is to become an editor for a fashion magazine. She finally bags an offer from a large publishing house, only to find out that she's been assigned to the least glamorous department in the company--the Proofreading Department.

title.de: 完全不倫 ― 隠す美学、暴く覚悟 ―

overview.en: Takuya Yoshioka loves his wife Chiharu. But when his friend tells him they've entered the great age of infidelity, he checks Chiharu's phone. Finding nothing suspicious, he regrets doubting her. But it turns out, it was all a trap. She has affairs to love her husband. He loves his wife despite her betrayal. Can you detect the hidden clues? ©NIPPON TV

title.de: 恋です! 〜ヤンキー君と白杖ガール〜

overview.en: A headstrong but love shy girl from a school for the blind meets a hot headed yet purehearted delinquent boy, an encounter that changes everything. Yukiko, who can barely make out light and color, and Morio, a quick to fight but sincere teen, grow closer as they understand each other. A heartwarming, funny new generation rom com inspired by Yankee kun to Hakujou Girl. ©Uoyama/KADOKAWA ©NIPPON TV

She has the perfect smile. The perfect career. She is beloved by all. He is a man of the world. A ladies’ man. A gifted accountant. Two people who seem to have it all, but not all that glitters is gold. This is a tale of two strangers releasing their inhibitions in a way that only strangers can. If only we could be like the beasts that roam wild and free…©NIPPON TV

title.de: 癒やしのお隣さんには秘密がある
title.en: The Neighbor of Healing Has a Secret

title.de: 結婚するって、本当ですか

overview.en: Rika and Takuya are single and thriving. One day, their manager announces that an unmarried employee will have to get transferred to Alaska! To dodge the bullet, the two plan a fake wedding. But then, they gradually fall for each other. From a loving couple's divorce to the reality of a childless marriage, this series closes in on the diverse form of marriage in the modern age.

title.de: A Million Ways to Die in the West
title.en: A Million Ways to Die in the West

overview.de: Arizona im Jahr 1882: Der Schafzüchter Albert lebt ein langweiliges Leben im Western-Kaff Old Stump. Seine Freundin hat ihn verlassen, nachdem er bei einem Duell aus Angst die Flucht ergriffen hat. Als die attraktive Anna und kurz darauf ihr Ehemann, der berüchtigte Bandit Clinch, in die Stadt kommen, wird der feige Albert jedoch zum Draufgänger. Um Anna zu beeindrucken, lässt er sich auf ein Duell mit Clinch ein. Dumm nur, dass Albert noch nie einen Colt abgefeuert hat.
overview.en: A pistol-packing woman helps a cowardly farmer find his inner courage, but when her outlaw husband rides into town seeking revenge, the farmer must put his new-found bravery to the test.

overview.de: Der Schwert schwingende Krieger Blade (Wesley Snipes) kehrt zurück, um die Reaper zu bekämpfen, eine neue Rasse von Super-Vampiren, die wild entschlossen sind, alle anderen Vampire zu vernichten und dann die gesamte menschliche Rasse auszulöschen. Blade verbündet sich mit einem schlagkräftigen Team von Vampiren, um ein größeres Übel zu besiegen als beide Seiten je zuvor bekämpft haben.
overview.en: The sword-wielding Blade returns to fight the Reapers, a new race of super vampires hell-bent on annihilating all other vampires before destroying the entire human race.
A new neighbor sets out to put so many Christmas lights on his house that they'll be seen in space.

title.de: Checker Tobi und das Geheimnis unseres Planeten
title.en: Checker Tobi und das Geheimnis unseres Planeten

overview.de: Sie kommen aus der Vergangenheit und der Zukunft Mischung aus stark: im Jahr 2032, erwachte aus dem Eis ewiger Verbannung, lief zu dem Cop und der Killer aus der heutigen Zeit.
overview.en: In a future without crime, a cop from the past is thawed to stop a brutal criminal from destroying everything that has been achieved.

overview.de: Der Grinch erzählt die Geschichte eines grantigen grünen Griesgrams, der Weihnachten verabscheut und beschließt, das ganze Fest zu stehlen, um seinen fröhlichen Nachbarn ein für alle Mal die Stimmung zu vermiesen. Doch rechnet er nicht mit der kleinen Cindy-Lou! Sie hat sich in den Kopf gesetzt, den Weihnachtsmann zu überraschen, und kommt damit dem Grinch in die Quere. Schafft sie es, sein verbittertes Herz zu erwärmen? Lustig, berührend und visuell grandios inszeniert! In der deutschen Fassung verleiht Otto Waalkes dem grünen Miesepeter seine Stimme -- ein Spaß für die ganze Familie!
overview.en: The Grinch tells the story of a cynical grump who goes on a mission to steal Christmas, only to have his heart changed by a young girl's generous spirit.

title.de: Der Online Killer - Der Tod kommt live

overview.en: Yinka Bokinni travels to New York State to interview notorious killer Brandon Clark

overview.de: Hiccup ist ein junger Wikinger, der sich über alle Konventionen hinwegsetzt, als er sich mit einem seiner tödlichsten Feinde anfreundet – einem wilden Drachen, den er Ohnezahn nennt. Doch Menschen und Drachen gelten eigentlich als Todfeinde, nicht als Freunde, und dieses ungewöhnliche Paar muss viele Hindernisse und eine ultimative Herausforderung überwinden, um ihre beiden Welten zu retten.
overview.en: After bonding with an injured dragon, a Viking teen learns that the creatures are friends, not foes.

overview.de: Zweiter Teil des drachenstarken Animationshits: Hicks und sein Drache Ohnezahn nehmen es mit dem rücksichtslosen Eroberer Drago Blutfaust auf, der Drachen für seine Armee versklavt.
overview.en: Hiccup (Jay Baruchel) and Toothless must save their people from a power-hungry invader.

title.de: Drachenzähmen leicht gemacht 3: Die geheime Welt
title.en: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World

overview.de: Wikinger Hicks und sein Drache Ohnezahn machen im dritten Teil des Animations-Hits eine tolle Entdeckung: Sie stoßen auf ein Drachenweibchen - das Ohnezahn den Kopf verdreht.
overview.en: When the sudden appearance of a female Light Fury coincides with the darkest threat their village has ever faced, Hiccup and Toothless must journey to a hidden world thought only to exist in myth. In this last chapter, Hiccup and Toothless will finally discover their true destinies, and dragon and rider will fight together to protect everything they've grown to treasure.

overview.de: Eine Handvoll unerschrockener Mädels gründet das erste Frauen-Baseball-Team der Welt - die Rockford Peaches. Als "Botschafterinnen des Charmes und weiblicher Schönheit" sollten sie antreten. Doch Coach Jimmy Dugan (Tom Hanks), der ständig beschwipste Alt-Star, hat andere Ziele. Er bringt die Truppe mit unerbittlicher Härte auf Vordermann. Zuschauern wie Gegnern vergeht angesichts des wilden Ha..
overview.en: The All-American Girls Professional Baseball League begins in 1943 with a has-been as a manager.

title.de: Go Trabi Go 2 - Das war der wilde Osten
title.en: Go Trabi Go 2: Those Were the Days of the Wild East

overview.en: The search for an astronaut on an alien planet.

title.de: How to Ruin Diwali: Meet the Parents
title.en: How to Ruin Diwali: Meet the Parents

overview.de: Der kultigen Teddy im Duffle-Coat macht wieder London unsicher. In seinem zweiten Filmabenteuer jagt der Kuschel-Bär den Dieb eines seltenen Buches. Mit der deutschen Stimme von Elyas M'Barek.
overview.en: Paddington must use his detective skills to catch a book thief in this fun-filled sequel.
The competition between Hong Do and Yoon Suk commences, much to the Dohwaseo's chagrin and to the interest of the royal court

overview.de: Notlandung im Kriegsgebiet: Gerard Butler bringt als Pilot seine Maschine auf einer umkämpften Tropeninsel runter. Mit einem FBI-Häftling muss er die Passagiere vor brutalen Rebellen retten.
overview.en: A pilot makes a risky landing on a war-torn island after a lightning strike, only to face new threats as he fights to protect his passengers.

title.en: High End: The Watch Theft Ring

overview.de: Der 13-jährige Connor leidet sehr unter der Krebserkrankung seiner Mutter und zieht sich jede Nacht in seine Fantasiewelt zurück, um sich mit ihrem bevorstehenden Tod auseinanderzusetzen. Immer exakt sieben Minuten nach Mitternacht zeigt sich ihm ein Ungeheuer in der Figur eines Baumes. Das Wesen nimmt Connor mit auf eine Reise und erzählt ihm Geschichten, deren Moral den Jungen dazu zwingt, sich mit seinen eigenen Ängsten zu konfrontieren.
overview.en: HD. A boy faced with the loss of his mother is guided by an unexpected visitor: a monster who tells him a trio of stories.
A warrior living in Goryeo dynasty meets a plastic surgeon living in the present day and both fight their way through the ordeals.
A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

overview.de: Adam Sandler, Seth Rogen, Leslie Mann und viele weitere Comedy-Größen in einer von Judd Apatow genial inszenierten Komödie über das Leben, den Tod und alles, was dazwischen so an verrückten Dingen passiert.
overview.en: Adam Sandler, Seth Rogen, Leslie Mann and an all-star cast of Hollywood’s most hilarious performers join together in Judd Apatow’s comedy about life, death and the funny stuff in-between.
A young woman from a poor family assumes a wealthy woman's identity in order to have the life she longs for.

Two women from different backgrounds pursue love and success in a society where money and status matter more than anything. A chaebol heiress falls for a poor man who wants to marry rich, while her friend dates her bethrothed, who loves her.
A cardiac surgeon and a rescue worker who, in their youth, were forced apart by harsh circumstances are reunited. Can a sweet first love be rekindled?

title.de: 南田南弁護士は天才肌
真田十勇士 SHADOWS OF THE TEN NINJA

overview.de: In diesem mitreißenden Horrorschocker von den Regie-Visionären von \"Talk to Me\" entdecken ein Bruder und eine Schwester ein schreckliches Ritual im abgelegenen Haus ihrer neuen Pflegemutter. Mit der Oscar-nominierten Sally Hawkins in der Hauptrolle.
overview.en: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

title.de: Ich weiß noch immer, was du letzten Sommer getan hast
title.en: I Still Know What You Did Last Summer

overview.en: Tormented by the brutal murders of her friends, college freshman Julie happily accepts her roommate’s invitation to a tropical paradise.

title.de: Ich weiß, was Du letzten Sommer getan hast
title.en: I Know What You Did Last Summer

overview.de: Julie, Helen, Barry und Ray überfahren einen Mann. In ihrer Panik werfen sie den scheinbar leblosen Körper ins Meer und schwören, über den Vorfall zu schweigen. Ein Jahr später holt sie ihre Tat ein: Ein Unbekannter nimmt blutige Rache.
overview.en: Teen friends vow not to reveal their accidental vehicular manslaughter after a night of partying, but a scary figure soon starts killing them off.

An urban legend is re-enacted as three teenage girls mysteriously disappear on homecoming night. The next day they resurface with no memory of their disappearance. Those responsible for the prank begin to be killed off one by one in urban legend fashion while one of the homecoming girls and her brother must solve the mystery behind the murders and it's connection to the past before it's too late.

title.en: No Dropping Out: Back to School at 35

overview.en: In 1997, Osama bin Laden declared war on the USA. Pulitzer Prize winner Peter Arnett embarked on a mission to locate and interview him.
A suicidal man and a deadly assassin encounter the world of immortality in this black comedy suspense thriller.

The “good life” is just one scam away. This thought takes root in the minds of two friends Bhargav and Siddhant after they read countless news stories of bank scams that have happened in the country and that a total of seventy-one thousand five hundred crores has been scammed. Together they devise a plan to open India’s first fake bank. Will they get away or will they get caught?

Director of cult classic Teeth, brings James Norton, Janet McTeer, Jena Malone and Ed Stoppard to this unnerving, supernatural horror, set in Victorian England. Following the birth of their daughter, a young couple begin to experience strange happenings in their home. When the eerie late-night visits become ever more menacing, they decide to fight the supernatural force. Prepare to be spooked!

overview.de: Smart, sexy und cool: Thriller von Steven Soderbergh ("Ocean's Eleven"). Müssen sich Michael Fassbender und Cate Blanchett als Agentenpaar zwischen Loyalität und Liebe entscheiden?
overview.en: An intelligence agent faces the ultimate test when his wife is suspected of betraying the nation.

title.en: The Siege: The Luga Defense Line

overview.en: Three rival karate street gangs in New York City are in a race against one another to find the lost finger-fighting manual authored by Bruce Lee.

Following the Cuban Revolution, Che Guevara, at the peak of his fame and power, vanishes without a trace. Resurfacing in Bolivia, he sets about recruiting insurgents to help him spread the revolutionary message. But communication lines are broken, support is lacking, and the CIA closes in on him.
Victor Kaapor goes undercover into the world of corrupt cops and mysterious kingpins to save his mother and the woman he loves.

title.en: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood

overview.en: "Godfather of the kung-fu film", Chang Cheh, made this treasured and beloved adventure featuring a sword, training manual, treasure map and a secret message. The kung-fu which ensues is as impressive as it is glorious.

title.de: Das Dreckige Dutzend III - Die tödliche Mission
title.en: The Dirty Dozen: The Deadly Mission

overview.en: Major Wright is ordered to rescue six scientists in occupied France who are developing a Nazi nerve gas that could change the course of the war.
An abandoned enemy trench isn't a refuge for a handful of British soldiers, as the men find themselves hunted by an unseen stalker.
In 1990 Albania, a government official is sent on a mission to a faraway prison in order to bring an important dissident back to the capital.

Matsugoro is a poor rickshaw driver whose animated spirit and optimistic demeanor make him a favorite of the town. Matsu helps an injured boy, Toshio, and is hired by the boy's parents, Kotaro and Yoshioko, to transport the boy to and from doctor appointments. Matsu comes to love the boy and his parents. When Toshio's father dies, Matsu becomes a surrogate father, helping to raise the boy and secretly falling in love with Toshio's mother Yoshioko. But Matsu knows there is a great gulf between their classes and there seems no hope that Matsu can ever be more than the rickshaw man to the mother and son.

overview.de: Hauptkommissarin Elisabeth Guardiano wird in das Bergdorf Roquenoir geschickt, um dort in einem grausamen Doppelmordfall zu ermitteln. Zeitgleich trifft auch Franck de Rolan in der kleinen Gemeinde ein, um die Entführung mehrerer Kinder aus der Gegend aufzuklären. Nichts deutet auf einen Zusammenhang hin. Doch dann stoßen Guardiano und de Rolan auf die uralte Legende des Seelenfängers ...n.
overview.en: During the investigation of multiple gruesome deaths that have plagued a small mountain village, an old legend emerges as a connecting force.

overview.de: Die junge Lehrerin Elizabeth Thatcher, die an das Leben in der gehobenen Gesellschaft gewöhnt ist, nimmt eine Stelle in der Minen-Stadt Coal Valley an. Sie will ihrer Familie zeigen, dass sie eigenständig im rauen Westen Kanadas leben kann.
overview.en: Hope Valley residents rally together to create a stronger community than ever before, welcoming newcomers to town, including many friendly faces... and a few not-so-friendly ones.

In 1999, Professor Amamori discovers that a new planet in our solar system is on a collision course with Earth. As doomsday preparations begin, Hajime begins uncovering the secrets of the universe in the classic space opera QUEEN MILLENNIA!
To find out if Parthia is planning to go to war with Rome, ten gladiators are sent to Arbela, where they decide to kidnap the beautiful queen.
A teacher poses as a billionaire's girlfriend - what could go wrong? Georgia Jackson hopes to put on a Christmas showcase with her students, but finds herself in the spotlight.
Led by Lieutenant colonel Ivan Lyon, a squad of 23 Australian and British soldiers leaves Fremantle for Indonesia in 1944 as part of Operation Rimau.

title.en: Elina: As If I Wasn't There

overview.en: Born on a remote island with economic limitations and physical limitations (due to his damaged hearing from fish bombing), Ellyas lost hope for his future. However, his fighting skills paved the way for Ellyas Pical to become a boxer, starting from an amateur champion to becoming a world champion.
Hired by the government to stage the assassination of a mobster, a special effects expert is double crossed and forced to use movie magic to survive.

Centered around 12th-grade students facing impending board exams, Rajat-Ishita and Pandu-Anusha navigates the delicate balance between love and studies. As Kaushal sir teaches in a different institute, doubts arise about his commitment to excellence. Rajat and Ishita embark on a journey, exploring the intersections of career and love and questions of a long distance relationship.

Japan is being targeted by criminals, and a group of secret agents (GOS) are secretly working to save the nation. They've got 72 hours to save Tokyo's 14 million residents from a terror attack by Mundo, a worldwide terrorist group. Can they do it in time? And what's Mundo's true goal? Watch as ninjas defeat their enemies using ancient ninja weapons in this exciting action film! (C) Toei Company
A vigilante is sent on a mission by the government to kill enemy troops, but things fall apart when he's mistaken for the troop leader.

title.en: In the Heat of the Night

overview.en: In the town of Sparta, Mississippi, a small-town police chief faces big-city crimes, grappling with murder, corruption, racism, and more.
A hunting expedition goes awry when another hunter decides to make the hunters the hunted.

title.de: Johannes XXIII - Für eine Welt in Frieden
Jules Verne - Die Phantastische Reise im Ballon

overview.en: Don't miss the remastered version of 'Fantastic Hot Air Balloon Trip.' In 1862, in England, two friends and a colored servant embark on a difficult challenge, traveling to unexplored places in a hot air balloon.

title.de: Land der Einzelkinder - One Child Nation

overview.en: Included with Prime November 8. In the 2019 Sundance U.S. Grand Jury Prize-winning documentary One Child Nation, Chinese-born filmmakers Nanfu Wang (Hooligan Sparrow) and Jialing Zhang expose the devastating consequences of China’s One-Child Policy through the stories of those who lived through it.

overview.de: Iris (Kate Winslet) und Amanda (Cameron Diaz) sind grundverschieden - die eine lebt in einem verträumten englischen Dorf, die andere bewohnt ein protziges Hollywood-Anwesen. Dennoch haben sie eine Gemeinsamkeit: Pech in der Liebe. Bei ihrer verzweifelten Suche nach einem Ausweg kreuzen sich ihre Wege im Internet. Spontan beschließen sie die Wohnungen zu tauschen. Doch statt stiller Einsamkeit...
overview.en: Two women – one living in L.A. and the other in England – try to change their romantic luck by switching homes for the holidays.

Alice, a newly separated mother, finds her life upended when three charismatic young men move into her guest house. Her new family and budding romance come to a crashing halt when her ex-husband shows up, suitcase in hand.

overview.de: Thriller im SUV mit Anthony Hopkins und Bill Skarsgård: Beim Versuch, ein Luxusauto auszurauben, wird Kleinganove Eddie darin eingesperrt. Der Besitzer erteilt ihm eine brutale Lektion.
overview.en: From producer Sam Raimi, this horror-thriller follows a petty thief (Bill Skarsgård) who breaks into the wrong car and becomes prey to its vengeful owner (Anthony Hopkins). Eddie faces a deadly game of survival, where escape is an illusion, and justice shifts into high gear.

title.de: LOL Surprise! The Skate Dance Movie
title.en: LOL Surprise! The Skate Dance Movie

overview.en: When Tween Ali Dance finds herself committed to ballet AND skateboarding at the same time, it all becomes too much.  Her friends - and little sister - help Ali find a new groove all her own.
After his daughter is kidnapped for witnessing a hijacking, a Texas Ranger and former Marine enters a deadly fight with an arms dealer to save her.

Luisana Lopilato is Denise, a sommelier who discovers a method to send messages to the past and uses it to fix a mistake. Great idea… in theory. In practice, her present spirals out of control, and every attempt to fix it makes things worse. Now, trapped in a loop of chaos, her life looks more like a badly mixed cocktail than a fine wine. Can she escape this mess before losing it all?
A globetrotting martial arts adventure involving a double-crossed assassin left for dead and the mysterious crime-fighting ring that saves him.
The DEA and Hong Kong Police join forces with the CIA and brilliant police woman Amazonia to bring down a ruthless crime lord.
A couple, who were in a long distance relationship for 3 years, face the prospect of getting married.
Una pareja recibe a su suegra en su casa durante unos días. Sin embargo, la suegra se queda más tiempo del esperado y crea problemas.

title.en: In the Line of Duty 5: Middle Man

overview.en: A man framed for espionage crimes, due to his friend’s illegal spying, flees the police, the CIA, and hit men with the help of his well-armed cousin.
All hell is about to break loose for a group headed to a rock festival and wind up astray in the creepy and dilapidated shanty town of Sant Marti.

overview.de: Der ehemalige Elite-Agent Michael Mason (Jason Statham) lebt auf einer abgelegenen Insel in Schottland. Als er in einem schweren Sturm ein Mädchen vor dem Ertrinken rettet, setzt er damit eine Kette von Ereignissen in Gang, die ihn zurück in die Welt zwingen. Dort muss er nicht nur um das Überleben der Teenagerin kämpfen, sondern sich auch den Dämonen seiner Vergangenheit stellen …
overview.en: On a remote coastal island, a former assassin living in self-imposed exile rescues a young girl from a deadly storm. As their lives start to intertwine, he must protect the orphan while battling enemies from his past.
In a lawless city where gangs rule the streets, a fighter seeks revenge against a gang for murdering his brother.
Real superheroes get better with age in this star-driven comedy about a group of senior superheroes who gather for one last mission.
A night of unimaginable terror awaits twelve-year-old, Bobby, and his best friend, Kevin, when they are abducted on their way home from school.
Joy is the new maid of a royal house, whose previous maid disappeared under mysterious circumstances.

title.de: The Operation - Im Sumpf der Korruption
title.en: Operation Carwash: A Worldwide Corruption Scandal Made in Brazil

overview.en: Polícia Federal: A Lei É para Todos is a Brazilian thriller movie of 2017. It was directed by Marcelo Antunez, produced by Tomislav Blazic and scripted by Thomas Stavros and Gustavo Lipsztein. It was inspired by the book of the same name by Carlos Graieb and Ana Maria Santos. Starring Antônio Calloni, portrays Operation Car Wash from the point of view of the police investigators who acted in it.
In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for other survivors as she grapples with the reality of an unborn child growing inside of her.
The showdown between a celebrated cop and a serial killer who challenges the former to nab him, results in consequences laced with heavy-duty action, playful romance and dark humour.

overview.de: Eigentlich ist Weihnachten in den Dolomiten Familientradition – nur diesmal droht alles im Chaos zu enden: Abbie und Jacob wollen sich trennen und planen stattdessen einen letzten gemeinsamen Sommerurlaub mit Tochter Claire. Doch die hat andere Pläne – und verwandelt das Urlaubsdomizil von Opa Lawrance heimlich in ein voll dekoriertes Weihnachtswunderland! Danny DeVito und Andie MacDowell bringen herrlich schlagfertig den Weihnachtsmann ins Schwitzen. Regisseur Peter Chelsom (WEIL ES DICH GIBT) zaubert eine originelle Weihnachts-Feelgood-Komödie mit Herz, Witz und viel Schnee mitten im italienischen Sommer.
overview.en: In a desperate bid to bring her parents back together, ten-year-old Claire asks to celebrate one last Christmas as family—in the middle of August.
As her loved ones suffer from the lasting effects of working in the coal mines, a Kentucky woman joins the picket lines for a long, violent strike.
In a remote village, a mission to catch a rogue, escaped buffalo unleashes the locals' own primal instincts, sparking a frenzy of violence.

overview.de: Um seine Frau vor einem Dämonenkönig zu retten, begibt sich ein rechtschaffener Kriegerprinz aus seinem langen Exil auf eine legendäre Odyssee über Land und See.
overview.en: Raghav, Ayodhya’s exiled prince, embarks on a quest to rescue his wife Janaki with the help of a monkey army, from the clutches of Lanka’s ten-headed demon king Raavan.
A writer with a broken heart and writer's block travels to a remote hill station where he rediscovers love and has to take on a copycat serial killer who has risen from the dead.
Chehre is a story about rights and wrongs. It’s a story about the decisions one makes in his / her lifetime and the fact that every decision has its repercussions, hearing and judgement.
The hit and run of an 18-year-old girl raises many questions, but the truth is rarely pure and never simple.

When a mysterious murder takes place at exiled billionaire Ashish Kapoor’s birthday party, the prime suspects are his close family and friends. ​As twists follow turns and devious motives are revealed, CBI officer Mira Rao must use all her skill to unravel a mystery where nothing is what it seems and everyone hides a secret or two.

overview.de: The film Shershaah is the story of PVC awardee brave Indian soldier Capt. Vikram Batra, whose indomitable spirit and unflinching courage in chasing the Pakistani soldiers out of Indian territory contributed immensely in India finally winning the Kargil War in 1999.
overview.en: The film Shershaah is the story of PVC awardee brave Indian soldier Capt. Vikram Batra, whose indomitable spirit and unflinching courage in chasing the Pakistani soldiers out of Indian territory contributed immensely in India finally winning the Kargil War in 1999.
Bored traffic cop Shakti stumbles upon the skeletal remains of a family and probes into the matter, crossing paths with the original investigator of the case.

Karnan lives in an oppressed remote village in Southern Tamil Nadu. Communal oppression haunts the village and continues preying on it as unprecedented events distort Karnan’s ordinary life. In the tremendous struggle that follows Karnan leads his village’s quest for justice and liberation. The subversive searing saga bears surrealistic touches as it tells a rousing story of rebellion.

overview.de: Inspired by the book ‘Simply Fly’, the film tells the story of Nedumaaran Rajangam known to friends as Maara, the son of a teacher, who sets out to make the common man fly and takes on the most capital intensive industry in the world with the help of his friends, family and sheer will power.
overview.en: Inspired by the book ‘Simply Fly’, the film tells the story of Nedumaaran Rajangam known to friends as Maara, the son of a teacher, who sets out to make the common man fly and takes on the most capital intensive industry in the world with the help of his friends, family and sheer will power.

An undercover cop goes to find and kill a crime lord. However, when he realizes that the crime lord's business intentions are good and he has his own challenges, he needs to decide his next step and help the crime lord change his life.

When his mother sees the fury cast upon him by the scorching lands he works in, and rueing the dangers of his own violent tendencies, Muthu’s mother sends him to work at Parotta Shop in Mumbai. Muthu’s journey takes a drastic turn as he is entwined in a vicious network of blood and crime. Floating like driftwood in water, Muthu finds himself in an inescapable limbo of crime and violence.

The cat and mouse game begins with Theresa’s posting in Chennai. Her vow to clean up the city from drugs leads her to Deva. Deva’s drive to be the drug lord is paved with murders and politics. People who enter Bava Lodge on that day are caught in the crossfire of deceit and betrayal between Deva and Theresa. Who will survive in the lodge? Will Theresa be able to catch Deva and end the drug war?
CI Shiva Kumar (Allari Naresh) is a brash police officer and it often causes problems both at work and home. What happens when the consequences of his actions catch up to him?

Raghava Rao (Prakash Raj), a celebrated theatre artiste who has ruled the stage for decades, decides to retire on a high to spend time with his family. While his intentions are pure, he struggles to come to grips with the new reality changing landscape, selfcentred family members and his glory days from the stage now behind him. Will he be able to play different characters that life throws at him?

An orphan soldier, Lieutenant Ram's life changes, after he gets a letter from a girl named Sita. He meets her and love blossoms between them. When he comes back to his camp in Kashmir,After he gets caught in jail, he sends a letter to Sita which won't reach her.

Vikram is a 30-year-old cop. While he is battling with his own traumatic past, the stakes get high when a girl called Preethi mysteriously disappears in Hyderabad and Vikram has to solve the case at any cost.

In the heart of 'Sapta Sagaradaache Ello’ (Somewhere Beyond the Seven Seas), lies an ardent love story between Manu & Priya. Their journey, set against the backdrop of a city's shadows, delves into the depths of their emotions. In a world where promises hold weight and fate’s grasp is firm, how far will Manu go to fulfil his promise? What becomes of love when destiny triggers an unexpected turn?

Joseph Chandy (Vivek Oberoi) an IPS officer and Kuriyachan (Prithviraj Sukumaran) a very rich plantation owner in Pala, Kottayam are at loggerheads over some issues that arise between the two of them. They continue to seek revenge on each other at every opportunity they get until one day they decide to fight it out, face to face at the church’s annual festival.

Cold Case is a hybrid genre film of a crime investigation story and a horror story running parallel. Sathyajith, Assistant Commissioner of Police, along with his team is assigned to handle controversial and complicated cases. One day, while fishing on a lake side, a man finds a garbage bag trapped inside his net.The story revolves how the ACP investigate the case and find out the killer.

When Nishanth (Biju Menon), a college lecturer, and DCP Harish Madhav (Suresh Gopi), a straightforward police officer, become involved in a crime, one of them must battle for justice and the other for his integrity. Both men must outwit one another in a network of deceit and mental tricks.

Joji, an engineering dropout and the youngest son of the rich plantation family lives with his aspirations of becoming a super wealthy NRI. But his father sees down on him as a proper loser. Driven by greed and blind ambition, Joji finally decide to execute his plans following an unexpected event in the family. Will he succeed in achieving his dreams?
A disheartened motivational speaker in Mumbai finds his life unraveling when he gets hired to pose as a Christian preacher and perform hoax miracles.
A priest and a police officer are trying to solve a set of mysterious suicides. As their investigation closes in, they discover another crime with even farther-reaching consequences
When a colleague lands a coveted job, a journalist throws away his moral principles and writes fabricated stories to become a major influencer.

John Baby,who is recouping from a traumatic accident,meets Nitin,a young boy who interests him with murder stories. When Baby explores the possibility of Nitin's stories by mapping the events,it matches with the real-time incidents.

Sidharth recalls his childhood and falling in love with Sruthi, which he ended for the sake of his brother. He remembers being jealous of the extra care his brother needed for critical health issues and landing in trouble.

title.de: สิงห์เหนือ เสือใต้

overview.en: "Every case leads to the final mystery." A clumsy detective and his genius assistant solve baffling cases that unexpectedly connect, revealing a shocking truth. As Anna and Kazama search for her missing father, each solved case brings new riddles-until they discover the key lies in a buried incident from 20 years ago. ©NIPPON TV

title.en: Hotaru no Hikari: It's Only a Little Light in My Life

overview.en: [With ENG Subtitles] Hotaru prefers sleeping over dating and loves lounging at home in a stained T-shirt and sweatpants, drinking beer, and scratching her bottom. But her cozy home life is disrupted when her boss unexpectedly moves into her home one day.

[With ENG Subtitles] Japanese society calls people who were born between 1987 and 2004 the "yutori generation." They are seen as having no ambition, no competitive spirit, and no sense of cooperation. Three men who are labeled as the "yutori generation," struggle with work, family, love, and friendship in this drama.

title.de: 俺のスカート、どこ行った?

overview.en: Nami Isayama, played by Haruka Ayase, is a well off full time housewife admired by many. Hoping to restart her life and find peace, she marries a man she met at a mixer and moves to a quiet upscale neighborhood. Soon she discovers the hidden troubles behind other housewives' lives. Though bad at housework, Nami has a strong sense of justice and rushes into danger without hesitation. ©NIPPON TV

An arson attack in QingYun County that results in a novel death penalty case; a psychiatrist driven by the desire for revenge; two friends, wrought with guilt after failing to lend a hand; a woman whose husband committed murder; and one verdict that tells the story of six families.
This series/video is only available in Japanese or in its native language with Japanese subtitles. Our service does not support English-language audiences for this content at this time.

As reports of crimes involving foreigners increase, so does the risk of prejudice and discrimination.Tokyo Salad Bowl delves into the lives of foreigners in Japan, a country evolving into a cultural "salad bowl." Told through the perspectives of a detective and an interpreter, the story reveals hidden struggles while celebrating the vibrant international cuisines that enrich the narrative.© NHK

[With ENG Subtitles] Talking about “coulda, shoulda, woulda", Rinko, unmarried and unsuccessful at her job, spends her days with her best friends from high school. One night, a young handsome man suddenly scolds them "You tarareba women!" Just like that, the ladies get a harsh reality check.

overview.de: A random mass stabbing, major food company Titus Foods, and a mysterious infant disease. These three things have as much in common as Detective Soma, hack writer Yarimizu, and the stabbing's lone survivor, Shuji. Yet, these men are now embroiled in a risky quest for the truth. What they find, though, is more heinous than they imagined, making them question just who is the real criminal?
overview.en: A random mass stabbing, major food company Titus Foods, and a mysterious infant disease. These three things have as much in common as Detective Soma, hack writer Yarimizu, and the stabbing's lone survivor, Shuji. Yet, these men are now embroiled in a risky quest for the truth. What they find, though, is more heinous than they imagined, making them question just who is the real criminal?
[With ENG Subtitles] As a journalist, Kate’s trained to expose the truth. But when she uncovers shocking details after her mother’s death, she faces her toughest “off the record”—her own birth.

Kahoko is a college student and the epitome of an overprotected child birthed by modern Japan. She has always been under the care of her helicopter parents. Her world changes when one day, a young man calls her out, saying, "People like you will ruin Japan!" Thus begins the story of her self-discovery, where every day she encounters something new. ©NIPPON TV
The founder of the Mistubishi gives an interview to a young reporter about an unknown samurai who challenged his society's suppressive caste system.
In this outrageous comedy, a group of high school Seniors juggle between old loves and new flings on the shores of a beautiful Italian town.

overview.de: Jedes Geräusch könnte das letzte sein, was sie hört: Emily Blunt kämpft in diesem Horrorhit mit ihrer Familie ums Überleben - umgeben von tödlichen Aliens, die Jagd nach Gehör machen.
overview.en: A family must live in silence to avoid mysterious creatures that hunt by sound.

A delightful blend of nostalgia, humor & drama. It is a coming-of-age story of the siblings of a typical orthodox family as they explore the changes in patriarchy, arranged marriages, gender roles and education and work opportunities for women through the 1960s-70s of Bangalore.

overview.de: Im vermutlich letzten gemeinsamen Urlaub der Familie möchte Jessica Tannen ihrer Familie das perfekte Weihnachtsfest bescheren. Aber mit einem erneut aufflammenden Streit der Geschwister, früh eintreffenden Verwandten und einem schelmischen Hund nimmt das komische Chaos immer mehr zu. Am Ende lernt Jessica, dass es die Liebe ihrer Familie ist, die Weihnachten zu etwas Besonderem macht.
overview.en: In what may be the last holiday with the family together, Jessica Tannen hopes to give her family the perfect Christmas. But with a never-ending task list, a sibling grudge reigniting, extended family arriving early, and a mischievous dog, the comical chaos is mounting. When mayhem ensues, Jessica learns that being surrounded by loved ones is what truly makes Christmas special
Tamo ninja Captain Scott teams up with the local law enforcement in a last attempt to bring down a ninja crime organization once and for all.
During the holiday season André Rieu invites you to a festive Christmas concert in his house. Rieu's romantic Christmas party is just what you need to get in the holiday mood.
HD. Thriller about a conservative family man who has to rely on his animal instincts when he unexpectedly faces a life-or-death situation.

The first black recruit in his squad, rookie cop JJ Johnson (Michael Boatman, The Good Wife) struggles to adapt to life on the force when confronted by the inherent prejudices and corruption of his precinct. Immediately positioned as an outsider, along with fellow novice cop Deborah (Lori Petty, Tank Girl, Orange is the New Black), JJ witnesses at first hand the brutality and implicit racism of his white colleagues. When an unlawful search results in the arrest of Teddy Woods (Ice Cube, Boyz N the Hood) on dubious murder charges, JJ risks his job and his life to reveal the truth. Directed by Charles Burnett (Killer of Sheep), this thrilling drama shines a light on the deep-rooted racial tensions of the American justice system and the toll of opposing institutionalised bigotry.
A Chinese cop searches for her boyfriend and collaborates with a kung-fu master to stop two Japanese gangsters from stealing a valuable painting.
A call to action against the agenda of Christian Nationalism that weaponizes faith in service of promoting authoritarianism and undermining democracy.

Dream Besties Barbie, Barbie, Teresa, Renee, Daisy, and Ken explore their biggest dreams in an alternate reality where anything is possible! The Dream Besties inspire each other to pursue their passions and believe in themselves! Live Out Your Best Dreams!

overview.de: Ben ist zurück - aber kann er seine Sucht wirklich hinter sich lassen? Julia Roberts kämpft um ihren Sohn - doch seine Drogenvergangenheit droht die Familie wieder in den Abgrund zu reißen.
overview.en: When her teenage son returns home from rehab on Christmas Eve, Holly does everything in her power to keep him safe and prevent him from relapsing.

title.de: Bethany - A Real American Horror Story

overview.en: Claire and her husband move into her childhood home, and traumatic memories of her abusive mother come back to haunt her. When her husband begins to work longer hours, a mysterious figure begins haunting Claire's memories. During the encounters, she finds herself living in the past as well as the present while trying to figure out what the figure wants from her.
A killer stalks a sorority house in this chilling feminist spin on the slasher horror genre.

To pay down a debt, a student joins a small underground crime syndicate and soon finds himself rolling in cash, drugs and girls. But when a brilliant but psychotic career criminal joins the crew with the ambition of taking over the drug trade, things quickly start to spin out of control.
Five young friends vacationing in Wisconsin get in a terrible car crash during a snowstorm and find themselves without cell service.

A blind woman develops an unexpected friendship with an ex-con, not realising that he's stuck on home detention - a sitting duck with a target on his back. As their bond deepens, she finds herself entangled in his past, and hiding in plain sight of a sadistic crime lord.

overview.de: Nach dem grausamen Tod ihres Kollegen untersucht eine Polizistin den Fall und entdeckt, dass eine übernatürliche Kraft es auf ihre Einheit abgesehen hat.
overview.en: A police officer discovers something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit.
Based on the true story of Brian Deneke, aversion to a group of punks in a conservative Texas town leads to violence and a controversial hate crime.
The leader of a brutal criminal organization is given seven days to leave town or die. Now he must race against time to find out who wants him dead.

overview.de: Broadchurch ist eine 8-teilige Dramaserie, in der untersucht wird, wie sich der Mord an einem Jungen - Danny Price - auf eine kleine Marktstadt in Dorset auswirkt. Es wird untersucht, was mit dieser kleinen Community passiert, wenn sie plötzlich im Mittelpunkt eines Großereignisses steht und dem vollen Glanz des Medienrampenlichts ausgesetzt ist.
overview.en: Grief and suspicion envelop a Dorset, England community making national headlines in the wake of the grisly murder of an 11-year-old local boy.

overview.de: Der für seinen Berufsstand zu groß geratene Elf Buddy wird vom Weihnachtsmann in die USA geschickt, um seine wahre Identität herauszufinden.
overview.en: As a baby, Buddy is whisked off to the North Pole, and raised as an elf. A misfit in his family, Buddy heads to his birthplace to seek out his roots.

title.de: Bully - Leider Live! Garantiert ohne Programm
title.en: Bully - Leider Live! Garantiert ohne Programm

overview.en: Wonderfully weird 70s adventures show. Meet Catweazle - the 11th-century wizard whose spell lands him in the modern day. How on earth will he cope?

overview.de: Die unterdrückte Sam Montgomery, die regelmäßig von ihrer bösen Stiefmutter ausgebeutet wird, ist begeistert von der Aussicht, ihren Internet-Schönheit beim Halloween-Tanz der Schule zu treffen.
overview.en: A teenage orphan under the thumb of an evil stepmother readies to meet her online soul mate at a high school Halloween dance and gets a seismic shock.
Kindra, a young woman who steals UN secrets and anonymously sells them online, finds herself in trouble after two groups close in on her.

Clay is a young man with a past who is befriended by a serial killer, in this black comedy with a satirical edge about double-double-cross. The trouble is every woman Clay introduces to his new friend ends up dead and its looking rather like he's done the deeds!

Clean Job is the story of a grief stricken, broken young woman named Kimberly, who grows up to be the ruthless master mind behind a criminal syndicate of desperate, poor women from the township, who disguise themselves as domestic workers, to rob rich people living in the suburbs of Johannesburg.

title.de: CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton
title.en: CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton

overview.en: A married woman's careless one-night-stand becomes a nightmare when her lover ruthlessly stalks her family, in this edge-of-your-seat thriller.

title.de: Cold Case - Kein Opfer ist je vergessen

overview.en: Headstrong Detective Lilly Rush works on cold cases for the Philadelphia Police Department, reopening dormant, unsolved homicides that occurred years or even decades ago. The resourceful Rush makes use of today's science and finds fresh clues to crimes once thought to be unsolvable.

After being insulted by a rich businessman named Rosario, pandit Jai Kishen teaches him a lesson by getting his daughter married to Raju - a Coolie posing as a millionaire. Soon Raju’s real indentity is exposed but he cooks up a story of having a filthy rich twin. One lie leads to another and things start to go out of hand.
The life and stories of Guillermo Coppola, famous "bon vivant" and Diego Armando Maradona's agent.
A crew of treasure hunters embarks on a diving expedition to uncover a 200-year-old sunken Spanish galleon lost in the Caribbean sea.

Based on Erich Kästner’s classic children’s novel. Martina takes up a scholarship at the Johann-Sigismund Gymnasium boarding school. She finds herself caught between the rivalry between the boarders and the “externals” from the local village.

overview.de: Paul Rudd und Jenna Ortega überfahren in dieser blutigen Horrorkomödie ein Einhorn. Während geldgierige Pharmabosse nur möglichen Profit sehen, will der Einhorn-Vater Rache.
overview.en: A father and daughter accidentally hit and kill a unicorn while en route to a weekend retreat, where his billionaire boss seeks to exploit the creature's miraculous curative properties.

Dr. Jan Diffring (Curd Jürgens) praktiziert als Arzt an der Reeperbahn und besitzt das volle Vertrauen der hier arbeitenden und lebenden Menschen. Niemals würde er der Polizei Informationen geben und wegsehen, wenn sich jemand in Not befindet.
Intense legal thriller about a rookie lawyer’s landmark case defending a man with no clear motive who is accused of killing a famous industrialist.

overview.de: Der Grinch erzählt die Geschichte eines grantigen grünen Griesgrams, der Weihnachten verabscheut und beschließt, das ganze Fest zu stehlen, um seinen fröhlichen Nachbarn ein für alle Mal die Stimmung zu vermiesen. Doch rechnet er nicht mit der kleinen Cindy-Lou! Sie hat sich in den Kopf gesetzt, den Weihnachtsmann zu überraschen, und kommt damit dem Grinch in die Quere. Schafft sie es, sein verbittertes Herz zu erwärmen? Lustig, berührend und visuell grandios inszeniert! In der deutschen Fassung verleiht Otto Waalkes dem grünen Miesepeter seine Stimme -- ein Spaß für die ganze Familie!
overview.en: The Grinch tells the story of a cynical grump who goes on a mission to steal Christmas, only to have his heart changed by a young girl's generous spirit.

overview.de: Der Grinch, ein grünes Wesen mit einem Herzen aus Stein, wohnt in den Bergen hoch über dem idyllischen Städtchen Whoville. Übellaunig und verschlagen haßt er eine Sache ganz besonders: fröhliche Menschen, zum Beispiel solche, die sich auf Weihnachten freuen. Also faßt er einen besonders perfiden Plan - er will das Christfest einfach stehlen.
overview.en: A curmudgeon hates the Christmas-loving Whos of Whoville.

title.en: The Last One Will Go to Hell

overview.de: Gibt es überhaupt einen Weihnachtsmann? "Der Polarexpress" nimmt uns mit auf eine Reise zum Nordpol - und hält für alle Zweifler ein außergewöhnliches Weihnachtsgeschenk bereit.
overview.en: Late on Christmas Eve, after the town has gone to sleep, a boy boards the mysterious train that waits for him--The Polar Express. When the boy arrives at the North Pole, Santa Claus offers him any gift he desires. The boy asks only for a bell from the harness of Santa's reindeer. But on the way home, the bell is lost. Christmas morning, the boy finds the bell under the Christmas tree, and when ...

When Daniel Summer (Maxwell Caulfield) moves into the guesthouse on the grounds of her home, Jessica Michaels (Linda Purl) is impressed with his impeccable manners and comes to believe that he's an ideal tenant. Unfortunately, she's wrong -- he's actually a murderous psychopath out to get her for her involvement in his father's death years earlier. Jessica's daughter, Laura (Stacy Hogue), senses something with David is amiss, but it may be too late to prevent further bloodshed.
A group of orphans must overcome their fears and trust a mythical new friend, as they embark on a journey to restore lost magic and save Christmas.
This Christmas, primary school teacher Paul Maddens is being charged with the biggest challenge of his life - mounting the school's musical version of the Nativity.

overview.de: Weihnachtskomödie von "Wedding Crashers"-Macher David Dobkin, der Vince Vaughn und Paul Giamatti als ungleiches Brüderpaar antreten lässt.
overview.en: When Santa Claus' little known, older brother, Fred, returns to the North Pole, the black sheep of the family manages to create comic chaos that almost destroys Christmas.
Colorado teens fight back after Soviet-led paratroops drop into town for World War III.
When her perfect husband kills himself, Elizabeth discovers his death may be more than suicide and starts to seek the truth.

title.de: Dragon - Love Is a Scary Tale

overview.en: On the day of her wedding, Princess Miroslava is kidnapped and carried away to a remote island, where she is held captive by a mysterious young man.
A former hotshot race car driver, now living a quiet life, is abducted by a thief and forced to be the wheel-man for a $9-million dollar heist.
After a young woman's boyfriend is murdered by an intruder, things worsen when she meets her friend's new boyfriend and suspects him to be the killer.

Mahi, a newly married woman, brings an antique Jewish box into her home. When Mahi and her husband Sam begin to have paranormal experiences, they soon learn that the box is a dybbuk containing an evil spirit. The couple then seeks the help of a rabbi to unravel its mystery. Will they survive this ordeal before their child is born?
A small but determined miniature horse travels to the North Pole to compete for a spot alongside the famous reindeer that pull Santa’s sleigh.
Dominik, a man who lost it all, enters a shelter for battered men in Berlin and starts to heal and love again with the help of those around him.

title.de: Empire Queen: The Golden Age of Magic
title.en: Empire Queen: The Golden Age of Magic

overview.en: In a kingdom where magic is forbidden, a charming trio of unlikely adventurers set out on a perilous and playfully lighthearted quest to recover the legendary Sovereign Wand, overthrow an evil queen, and restore magic for all.

title.de: FANatic - An den Grenzen der Fiktion

overview.en: Tired of her stereotypical role, the lead of a popular sci-fi series is ready to call it quits, but her superfan assistant won’t let that happen.

overview.de: Als urplötzlich Menschen in Flammen aufgehen, tritt einer derjenigen, die das Feuer kontrollieren können, der Fire Force bei, um zu verhindern, dass ganz Tokio abbrennt.
overview.en: Tokyo is burning, and citizens are mysteriously suffering from spontaneous human combustion throughout the city! Responsible for snuffing out this inferno is the Fire Force, and Shinra is ready to join their fight. Now, as part of Company 8, he'll use his devil's footprints to help keep the city from turning to ash! But his past and a burning secret behind the scenes could set everything ablaze.
Three retired war veterans find themselves in the crosshairs of both the Mafia and the Feds after stumbling upon a hidden stash of money.

title.de: Galveston - Die Hölle ist ein Paradies

overview.en: After escaping a trap and rescuing a sex worker in New Orleans, a hitman on borrowed time returns with her to his Texas hometown to plot his revenge.
A new recruit out of London's East End begins working for a high-profile gangster and climbs his way to the top by way of lies and murder.
While serving time, an ex-Marine learns that a corrupt captain is using the prison's vicious attack dogs to hunt inmates for sport.

Getting Naked: A Burlesque Story peels back the curtain to reveal the sexy sub-culture of the neo-burlesque scene in New York City. This verité documentary intimately follows four performers, each of whom has discovered a newfound identity and belonging in a world of bawdy comedy and striptease.

overview.de: GHOSTS ist eine Ein-Kamera-Komödie über Samantha und Jay, die sich in ein waghalsiges und teures Abenteuer stürzen und entscheiden, das Weingut, das sie geerbt haben, in eine Frühstückspension umzuwandeln.
overview.en: The US version of the hit UK series. A couple inherit a crumbling mansion - and a gaggle of ghouls, from a saucy 1920s lounge singer to a 1960s hippy. It's a live-in nightmare!

While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend.

overview.de: Irgendwo in Iowa: Gilbert Grape ist einer der jungen Gefangenen dieser Einöde. Seine übergewichtige Mutter vegetiert seit dem Tod ihres Mannes vor dem Fernseher. Gilbert kümmert sich um seinen geistig behinderten Bruder Amie, der ihn mit seinen allwöchentlichen Versuchen, auf den Wasserturm zu klettern, auf Trab hält und für eine wenig Aufregung in der sonst so schläfrigen Ortschaft sorgt.
overview.en: After his father’s death, a young man is forced to take care of his mentally disabled brother and morbidly obese mother in a sleepy midwestern town.
A Gnome Queen awakens, and a cursed cop must stop a townwide massacre.
Plagued by seemingly endless bad luck,including the accidental death of her fiance,a young woman trains to compete as a sharpshooter at the national level.

title.en: Aro Tolbukhin in the Mind of a Killer

overview.en: Hey AJ! is a whimsical and music-filled family comedy about AJ, a girl with a big imagination who makes ordinary life moments extraordinary.
A young Australian woman's life turns nightmarish after she marries a handsome German immigrant who turns out to be a fanatical neo-Nazi.
On the trail of her missing sister, a woman enlists the help of an alcoholic ex-Marine to infiltrate a secluded religious community of snake handlers.

After middle school, with its bullying and nicknames, Uka Ishimori is excited for a fresh start at Hachimitsu High School. Kai Miura, a cool and uninhibited boy, sits next to her in class. Uka remembers she met Kai in middle school and with a single word, he had convinced her to attend Hachimitsu. Though he’s popular, Kai supports Uka in her efforts to fit in with her new classmates.
This fascinating miniseries explores the life and work of acclaimed magician Harry Houdini: from his rise to fame, to his surprising spy affiliation.

title.de: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
title.en: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads

overview.en: A musician plagued by insomnia is pulled into an odyssey with a stranger who begins to unravel the very core of his existence.
In this gripping thriller based on a true story, two desperate parents take the law into their own hands after their daughter mysteriously disappears.

Jaspreet Singh takes on "mundane" topics like the ever-growing motivation market, godmen, serious parenting to the "tough" bouncers like his door bell, the salad he made and the absurdity of the teenage. His first comedy special is a perfect amalgamation of his niche observations, signature laid back attitude with quick paced punchlines.
Courage and stunning self-sacrifice clash against the powers of evil in this WWII epic set in the aerial battlefields of war-torn Europe.

title.en: AI and the Death of the Internet

overview.en: This talk is given by Bryan Alexander of Georgetown University.
A man learns that the biological father he knew nothing about is involved in a world of crime, and, upon his death, is expected to join his family.
Four men are thrust into the position of saving the world when they find a UFO crash site and become genetically equipped to the battle suit on board.
An artist grows distant from his new wife as his irrational horror of premature burial consumes him.

Hélène Cattet and Bruno Forzani turn their genre-scrambling attention to European crime films of the 1970s with this kinetic brain-melter. Fixing Sergio Leone in its stylistic crosshairs, Let the Corpses Tan reduces plot to essentials, all the better to let rip with a psychedelic formal assault.

Ruthless executive Christine (Kristen Scott Thomas) takes delight in toying with the innocence of her assistant, Isabelle (Ludivine Sagnier), passing her young protege's ideas on as her own. Confident of her control over Isabelle, Christine leads her into a confusing, perverse game of seduction and domination, but ultimately underestimates Isabelle's ambition and cunning, leading to an all-out boardroom battle with deadly consequences.
Upon discovering her husband's infidelity, a newly single woman moves to New York with her two children and falls for their much younger male nanny.
In post-Katrina New Orleans, a disgraced detective gets a second chance when the ghost of a murdered woman wants to help him identify her killer.
When the facts don’t add up around her sister’s suicide, Lisa’s search for the truth draws her into a criminal underworld with a mysterious man.
A sun-soaked reality series follows singles seeking love while public pressure shapes every choice.

Arjun and Anu are childhood friends. Anu proposes out of convenience but their marriage turns out to be a nightmare since he is not really in love with her. While applying for a divorce, an unexpected twist gives Arjun a second chance. Will they live happily or will they get divorced?
A young woman finds a path to internet stardom when she collaborates with a magnetic stranger to make videos for her YouTube following

A Director calls for an audition and makes a movie out of it by creating conflicts between the artists who attend the audition. First of its kind realistic commercial film in Kannada that has multiple characters and touches upon current social conflicts in a humorous and satirical way

title.de: Mein Schatz, unsere Familie und ich

overview.en: Every holiday season happy couple Brad and Kate escape divorced parents and exasperating relatives by getting on a plane. This year a fog rolls in that even Rudolph's nose couldn't illuminate, the airport shuts down and the couple is forced to celebrate four Christmases in one hectic, hilarious day. Vince Vaughn and Reese Witherspoon lead an all-star cast in a comedy brimming with good cheer...
