Filmmaker Niko von Glasow travels the world to meet Paralympic competitors.

title.de: Meine Braut, ihr Vater und ich

overview.de: Ben Stiller will in der Erfolgskomödie um die Hand seiner Freundin anhalten. Doch sein Schwiegervater in spe (Robert De Niro) ist ein harter Hund - und macht ihm das Leben zur Hölle.
overview.en: Hoping to propose, Greg Focker must first impress his girlfriend’s parents, which proves difficult when her ex-CIA father instantly distrusts him.

title.de: Meine Frau, ihre Schwiegereltern und ich

overview.de: Meine Frau, ihre Schwiegereltern und ich
overview.en: Family bonding goes hysterically haywire when Greg Focker introduces his free-spirited bohemian parents to his stern, ex-CIA future father-in-law.
Un photographe désespéré qui souffre d'une maladie dégénérative des yeux et un mari qui veut tuer sa femme mourante complotent pour récupérer son assurance vie.
The brother and reluctant guardian of an autistic woman must decide whether or not she should undergo an experimental procedure that might cure her.

A widowed British businessman (John Malkovich) takes the job as a butler of a manor house in France to keep memories of his late French wife. His life takes a turn as he navigates the eccentric behaviour of the lady of the manor and the household staff.

overview.de: Als ein Dichter und seine Frau unerwarteten Gästen ihre Tür öffnen, verwandelt eine Reihe verstörender Ereignisse ihr Heim in einen Albtraum. Jennifer Lawrence spielt die Hauptrolle im atemberaubenden Thriller von Regisseur Darren Aronofsky.
overview.en: Terror strikes when a mysterious man and his family stay as guests in a couple's Victorian mansion.

title.de: My Instant Death Ability Is So Overpowered, No One in This Other World Stands a Chance Against Me!
title.en: My Instant Death Ability Is Overpowered

overview.en: Yogiri Takatou missed a few things during his nap. When he wakes up, he finds out that he and his entire class are in another world and must now team up with Tomochika and fend off danger with his Instant Death ability. If he can keep his eyes open, that is...
A small family of castaways must battle to survive against untold terrors when their hot air balloon lands on an uncharted island.

title.de: Mythos St. Moritz - Luxus, Schnee und Eskapaden
title.en: Summits & High Society – History of St. Moritz

overview.de: Ben Stiller in der Hauptrolle als Eddie, der 40-jährige Junggeselle, der endlich der schönen Lila sein Ja-Wort gibt. Aber während ihrer Flitterwochen entpuppt sich die Frau seiner Träume als ein völliger Alptraum.
overview.en: Ben Stiller stars as Eddie, the 40-year-old confirmed bachelor who finally says "I do" to the beautiful and Lila. But during their honeymoon, the woman of his dreams turns out to be a total nightmare.
An anxious new teacher must chaperone a class trip to a Christmas singing competition alongside his pregnant wife and an immature teaching assistant.

This Christmas the children of St. Bernadette’s primary school face their biggest adventure yet as they enter a Christmas flashmob competition to win a trip to New York! The only problem is their new teacher Mr Shepherd has lost his memory and can’t recall anything about Christmas, and even worse – he has no idea where he left Mr Poppy’s beloved donkey. Now the children must remind Mr Shepherd of what Christmas is all about before their Christmas turns into the most disastrous ever.
Star-crossed lovers find themselves torn apart by deadly cultural tensions between the East and West.

Released after 20 years in prison, ex-con Charlie Sundstrom returns to his home town to find that his estranged son, who has disappeared into the criminal underworld, is being hunted by a ruthless gang leader.

Article 99 is a fictitious hospital regulation at a Veterans' Administration hospital that promises full medical benefits...but, in fact, does not.  A spunky surgeon and his compatriots try to thwart the bureaucracy.

overview.de: Das Lachen von Julia Roberts. Der Charme von Hugh Grant. Das lebendigste Viertel von London. Das alles zeigt die wunderschöne Liebesromanze, die die Frage stellt: Kann sich der berühmteste Filmstar der Welt in einen ganz gewöhnlichen Mann verlieben?
overview.en: A shopkeeper (Hugh Grant) meets a movie star (Julia Roberts).

title.de: Off Limits - Wir sind das Gesetz

overview.en: Two police officers have to prove their innocence in a shooting by infiltrating a drug ring.
The film is said to be based on the emotional bonding between a boy and a dog and their love and affection for each other.

title.de: Once Upon a Time at Christmas
title.en: Once Upon a Time at Christmas

overview.en: A teen girl and a cop must solve the pattern behind seemingly random homicides when a serial-killing Santa and Mrs. Claus terrorize their small town.
Gopi, an arts and crafts professor, on his first day at work faces the task of saving the school which has been taken hostage by four radical social media activists.
Over the course of one evening, Matt Mercado is sent down a path of violence as a tragic event unfolds that will tear his world apart.

Unique and breathtaking, the kuril island “Onekotan” is part of the pacific fire ring, somewhere between Kamchatka and Hokkaido. The island is uninhabited, set in the middle of some of the stormiest and coldest seas in the world. It hosts a perfectly circled lake with a volcano at its center. An island within an island. In 2014, Matthias Haunholder and Matthias Mayr were so fascinated that they decided to go there for skiing, no matter what it would take to realize their dream. Over one year of planning, they increasingly understood why no one else would attempt such a feat. Finally in April 2015 they landed on the Island. Their goal was to ski, 18 days later, things changed. Survival and eventual escape became their main objective. But how? Boats did not want to pick them up due to stormy seas. Watch this very unique documentary about exploring new terrain, pure team spirit and the mentality of being adventurous.

Osman, is a small scale entrepreneur in a middle class neighborhood of Istanbul where he operates from a hangar transformed into an office. He dreams of getting rich through the sales of products imported from the Far East and also self invented products, thus marrying the girl he loves from the neighborhood. The biggest challenge he faces to marry the girl he is in love with is to convince the girl's father that he is a successful businessman. Osman believes the only way to do this is making a big breakthrough with his company. He embarks on many adventures to sell his products, all end up in hilarious misfortunes and failures. On his journey to become rich, the only companions he has are Erkan and Songül who is the daughter of a family friend from the neighborhood. At the end of the day Osman will come to realize that wealth was never far-off.

title.de: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
title.en: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry

overview.en: By day, Richard Haig (Pierce Brosnan), is a well-respected professor at Trinity College in Cambridge, where he teaches 18th century romantic poetry. By night, Richard indulges his own romantic fantasies with a steady stream of beautiful undergraduates, including his most recent beau Kate (Jessica Alba).

Rahul talks to people. Then people talk to Rahul. Thus, a conversation happens. Conversation is funny. Audience enjoys therefore. It’s recorded on camera and mic. Then edited. Now you are watching. Please watch. There is nothing valuable in this description.

Do you believe in Santa Claus? On the eve of Christmas a young boy sets out to discover the truth behind several strange goings on in his small isolated village. Why have all the reindeer been slaughtered? Who took all the hairdryers and radiators? And where have all the children gone? Seal the chimney. Lock the doors. Hide your children. This year the real Santa Claus is coming to town.
A man finds the wallet of a rich man and takes a long trip in an old car to return it, finding an old love and a new life of luxury awaiting.

Recep Ivedik goes through a number of adventures once again in the sequel. His grandmother, who is as hirsute as he is and loves to play PlayStation, wants him to find a job, start a family, and become a respected member of the community. If he doesn't, he won't inherit his grandmother's only possession: a mysterious chest. To fulfill his grandmother's desires, Recep once again stumbles from one adventure to the next, until he is actually holding the chest in his hand. It contains something totally unexpected.

While offering his condolences to the widow of his recently departed friend İsmet, Recep İvedik is saddened by her predicament and decides to help out. Together with Nurullah, they take the road to finish the last contract taken by her late husband, bus driver İsmet. Thinking that it will be a short trip, Recep finds out too late that the contract is about transporting a group of young athletes abroad to an international sports competition.  Things get complicated when team members face a serious misfortune and Recep is forced to take control. Deciding that only way out of this is by winning at the events, Recep tries to handle everything with his unique methods, causing all kinds of hilarious results.  This fifth adventure of Recep İvedik character, created by Şahan Gökbakar, is ready to meet its audience once more as a peerless comedy adorned with fun and entertainment.

Our hero, Recep İvedik is at home watching television, when postman brings him a surprise invitation for the annual dried beans festival of Konya province. Very excited with the news, Recep convinces his best friend Nurullah to join him but due to a miscommunication with the travel agency, they get plane tickets for Kenya, Africa, instead of Konya, Turkey. After arriving at Kenya and getting on a safari tour, our hapless companions find themselves lost in endless savannah and at the middle of two rival local tribes. Many adventures await Recep in this unfamiliar and exotic land, who will try anything and everything to return home, mostly to hilarious results. This new installment of box-office record-breaking series Recep İvedik, created by Şahan Gökbakar, promises many moments of laughter and fun to its audience.

Weary of the increased cost of living and hustle and bustle of the city, Recep takes Nurullah and travels to the village home he inherited from his grandmother. Busra, a lawyer from Istanbul parks her trailer home next to Recep’s neighboring land. At first, they get off on the wrong foot, but soon they find themselves on an exciting adventure to save the village from a great danger.
Huge laughs and lots of red faces! How well do Romesh’s celeb mates know their families? Find out here in this all new quiz show.

Trini's daughter is sad that her best friend is leaving Saint Michael School since her mother can't keep paying for it. Trini promises her daughter that this won't happen and decides to put together a plan with the other "mamis" of the group to solve the problem. But this mission will be much more difficult than they thought and they will have to stick together as a group.
After learning of his daughter's brutal murder, a convicted bank robber breaks free from his prison transport and teams with a cop to find the killer.

Nirmal and Naseeb are happily married couple. Even after 8 years of marriage they don’t have child. On suggestion of her mother-in-law, Naseeb persuades Nirmal to have a second marriage with her younger sister Kirna. Sharing her husband proves to be a difficult task for Naseeb. And this begins the squabbles between the two wives which lead to comic situation.
At their limit with the head of their family and his sadistic ways, a mother and daughter make a choice to murder him in cold blood.

Amidst pressures from his parents to hurry up and wed, a young man seeks his perfect match. After many failed attempts with matchmakers, his parents are delighted when their son finally meets the woman of his dreams but things do not go as planned.

“Girdhari” an old golden hearted guy, is desperate to find a match because of his growing age. His desperation lands him into trouble every time he meets a gorgeous girl. He doesn’t care about his surroundings, whether he is attending a marriage or a funeral, he always makes everyone around him uncomfortable. The only person who understands him is his father. Does Girdhari find his true love?

Dr. Ko Yowai is a happy-go-lucky but an absolutely brilliant psychiatrist. Yuri Amamiya is his slightly outspoken assistant nurse with a heart of gold. Together, they're waiting for the day when everyone feels comfortable visiting a psychiatrist. This is Shrink, the emotional drama series for those navigating the effects of mental health issues. ©Jin Nanami · Tsukiko /SHUEISHA ©NHK/AX-ON
Marek Kozakiewicz’s intimate documentary debut follows Aga, who moves back home to Poland to care for her brother whilst hiding her relationship from the authorities.
Samantha Walker faces her mysterious past by traveling to Germany to understand her former life at a convent, but a masked monk has other plans.
A loving wife throws her conscience away when she kills her husband’s blackmailer to protect his law career, while watching him try a framed person.

Gary Neville, Roy Keane, Jamie Carragher, Ian Wright and Jill Scott bring you “Stick to Football,” The Overlap's flagship football programme. The panel delivers honest discussion, expert analysis, and first-hand insight into the biggest stories within the game. The show also welcomes some of the biggest names from football, sport, and entertainment for exclusive interviews, with guests including David Beckham, Thierry Henry, Wayne Rooney, Steven Gerrard, Ruud Gullit, Rory McIlroy, Ronnie O'Sullivan, Luke Littler, Ricky Gervais, Ant & Dec, and Johnny Marr.

title.de: Stick to United With Wayne Rooney
title.en: Stick to United With Wayne Rooney

overview.en: Storks deliver babies…or at least they used to. Now they deliver packages for a global internet retail giant. But when an order for a baby appears, the best delivery stork must scramble to fix the error by delivering the baby.
Rivals turned friends find their bromance tested when they battle it out to win not only a grueling school competition, but also the same girl's heart.

In the 1960s, friends Sandy, Boo, Scollop, and Robbie head to a beach north of Sydney with the idea to throw a bachelor party of sorts for Sandy, celebrating his imminent wedding. When Sandy rejects Boo's suggestions for the weekend's debauchery, tension rises to a boiling point. At a local dance night event, Boo gets close to a teenaged girl, named Caroline, whose father owns a caravan park. Caroline's dad learns about what transpired between the two and searches for Boo with a loaded gun.
The SuperKitties showcase their superhero skills.
Montpellier police investigators Léa Soler and Paul Marchal work together. They are both single parents and recently divorced from one another.
Contestants will be asked to complete comedic and bizarre tasks in hopes of being crowned the Taskmaster Champion.
The unexpected death of their father brings two estranged sisters back home where a dark secret from their childhood summons an unspeakable evil.
Thrilled to have earned a spot on the cheerleading team, a college freshman soon discovers that the squad is a front for an escort ring.

title.de: The Disappeared - Das Böse ist unter uns

overview.en: When Matthew hears chilling voices on the recording of a news conference he visits a clairvoyant who reveals a history of missing children in the area. When a friend's sister is also abducted, the ghostly voices guide him to an underground labyrinth and a terrifying confrontation with the killer.
Power. Lies. Corruption. David Tennant & Robert Carlyle lead an all-star cast in this explosive true crime drama about the phone hacking scandal that rocked Britain.

Combat is part of life. The talented members of Team KOTOBUKI use their impressive aerial fighting skills to help defend and transport goods across a desolate wasteland. For the right price, they’ll take on any enemy that comes their way!
When Sharon finally tracks down her missing sister, she’s elated to be reunited—until she begins to suspect that she isn't her sibling after all.
This drama series follows a group of young dancers at the Next Step Dance Studio as they prepare for and compete in various competitions, with relationships and loyalties tested along the way.

Is this a film about Scrooge? About a composer's life? An opera within an opera? "The Passion of Scrooge" blurs these lines between performance, documentary, and fiction, into a cinematic concert experience seasoned with magical reality. Composer Jon Deak's opera, based upon Charles Dickens' timeless tale, is adapted by director H. Paul Moon into this new film featuring baritone William Sharp.
Looking for peace from the outside world, a mysterious stranger checks into a remote hotel that isn’t quite the serene escape that was advertised.

title.de: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
title.en: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County

title.de: The Storied Life of A.J. Fikry
title.en: The Storied Life of A.J. Fikry

overview.en: A.J. Fikry's life is not turning out as he expected and hits emotional and financial rock bottom. He lives alone, his bookstore is in a sales slump, and his most valuable possession, a book of poems, has been stolen. But when a mysterious package appears, he soon discovers he has a second chance at life, and love.
Mysterious events surround two travelers, presumably brothers, who cross a remote American landscape, as a web of dark, complex secrets is revealed..

Everyone knows the story of the Pom-Pom Mom and how she tried to hire a hit man to kill her daughter’s cheer rival.  For the first time, her daughter Shanna reveals the shocking secret behind what happened -- and who set her mother up.

title.en: Zoo Doctor: My Mon the Vet

overview.en: For eight seasons, Dr. Susanne Mertens has cared for animals at Leipzig Zoo, experiencing both heartwarming and dangerous moments. From raising young creatures to treating injured ones, her work demands courage, empathy, and devotion every day.

overview.de: In der ersten Staffel wird unter anderem erzählt, wie die Influencerin Mahek Bukhari und ihre 45-jährige Mutter zu Doppelmörderinnen wurden und wie die Influencerin Alexis Sharkey von ihrem Ehemann misshandelt und erdrosselt wurde.
overview.en: A series uncovering TikTok-linked murders with victims’ stories at the heart of each case.

Peter Ustinov won an Oscar® for Best Supporting Actor in this lighthearted thriller about five thieves (including Melina Mercouri, Maximilian Schell and Robert Morley) who undertake an "absolutely impossible" grand theft in Istanbul.
A wandering hustler becomes entangled in a tense and intricate web of trouble and betrayal after being hired to kill a man's wife.
Aspiring chef Lizzy sets off with her friends to compete in a food festival, which quickly turns into a series of heartwarming misadventures.

overview.de: Ben Stiller, Jack Black und Robert Downey Jr. führen ein Ensemble in "Tropic Thunder", einer Action-Komödie über eine Gruppe von Schauspielern, die darauf abzielen, den teuersten Kriegsfilm zu machen.
overview.en: A cast of A-list actors plays a troupe of self-absorbed actors, who, while filming a war movie, are forced by circumstances to become real soldiers.
When an adolescent girl meets her first boyfriend online, he turns out to be a sexual predator who tears the life of her happy suburban family apart.
A man who returns to his Brooklyn home is torn between two women: the sweet, comforting one his parents prefer, and an alluring, mysterious neighbor.
Set in a world of power, betrayal, lust, and war, this series focuses on the reign of King Louis XIV and the development of the Palace of Versailles.

Yukiya spends his free time as a DJ for a crowd of one and uploads his videos online while yearning for something greater than his current life. One day, he live streams a performance that will change his world forever.
A man caught in the middle of a sting operation orchestrated by the FBI gets a second shot at life when a priest offers him shelter.

overview.de: Der arrogante Werbefachmann und Macho Nick kann plötzlich hören, was Frauen denken. Natürlich setzt er sein Talent sofort gegen seine neue Chefin Darcy ein.
overview.en: A freak accident lets an ad exec (Mel Gibson) read women's minds.

title.de: When Lightning Flashes Over the Sea
title.en: When Lightning Flashes Over the Sea

overview.de: When Lightning Flashes Over the Sea ist eine filmische Reise durch das kriegsgezeichnete Odesa, in der Regisseurin Eva Neymann poetisch die Lebenswelten und Träume der Stadt und ihrer Bewohner einfängt: Geschichten von Verlust, Hoffnung und Widerstand - zwischen bröckelnden Fassaden, Lichtinseln und der allgegenwärtigen Dunkelheit des Krieges.
overview.en: When Lightning Flashes Over the Sea ist eine filmische Reise durch das kriegsgezeichnete Odesa, in der Regisseurin Eva Neymann poetisch die Lebenswelten und Träume der Stadt und ihrer Bewohner einfängt: Geschichten von Verlust, Hoffnung und Widerstand - zwischen bröckelnden Fassaden, Lichtinseln und der allgegenwärtigen Dunkelheit des Krieges.
In the South of France, suicidal Guillaume meets Vedrana, who’s trapped in a loveless relationship and determined to help him believe in love again.

overview.de: Dorothy wird dazu verleitet, Tinman und Scarecrow in die reale Welt zu entlassen, nur um dann ihre blutrünstigen Gelüste kennenzulernen.
overview.en: Haunted by nightmares, Dorothy is tricked into unleashing Tinman and Scarecrow into the real world, only to discover their blood thirsty cravings.

title.en: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory

overview.en: Yaar Mera Titliaan Warga is the story of a Couple who, after 6 years of marriage, are bored from each other. To spicy things up, both of them open fake Facebook accounts. But things go sideways when, accidentally, they befriend each other on FB. This "Comedy of Errors" take them on a humorous as well as emotional ride.

Wanja, Greta, Sören , Maul and Leona don't want to be adults under any circumstances. They must avoid being assigned the right job by an algorithm at all costs. Despite numerous attempts to confuse the algorithm, Wanja is assigned her dream job as an architect. But she soon realizes that the steep career path comes at a price: her friendships.
New Domino City, the playground of legendary duelist Yugi Muto, has transformed into a futuristic society where dueling has kicked into overdrive.

Chhorii is the story of a modern, young couple, Sakshi (Nushrratt Bharuccha) and Hemant. Sakshi is eight months pregnant with her first child when the couple, forced out of their home, escapes from the city and seeks refuge in a house located deep inside sugarcane fields. The house is inhabited by an old couple who seem to know more than they tell.

“JugJugg Jeeyo” is a story set in Patiala that’s about love, laughter, colour and drama. After a lifelong friendship and a 5 year marriage, Kuku and Naina need to tell their family that they want a divorce. However, Kuku’s parents, Bheem and Geeta have other plans set in store for them; all this amidst his sister’s wedding. It’s about family, values, unresolved yearnings and unexpected reunions.

An inspiring story about an orphan boy from the streets of Dongri, who grows up to become a local goon of his area and how his life changes after he meets the young and compassionate Ananya, who guides him towards the right path and makes him realize his true calling i.e boxing. Toofaan is set in Mumbai, It is a true cosmopolitan city and a melting pot for various cultures and religion.

The film is set in the fictional town of Balrampur where Vedvyas Tripathi (Vicky Kaushal) better known as Bhajan Kumar lives with his family headed by his father Pandit Siyaram Tripathi (Kumud Mishra). Bhajan Kumar’s life with his family was going well till a question on his identity arises that throws the city in a flurry of rumour and apprehension. Will he survive or fall prey to this onslaught?

In the skullduggery world of politics and crime, an innocent Chanchal has to put all on the line to prove her innocence and bring justice to Shakti and the people that he loved so much. As she gets embroiled deep in a web of deceit, Chanchal must face powers both natural and supernatural to fulfil her destiny.

Kabir agrees to travel to his native place to complete the legal formalities of his mother's properties. Reluctant to meet his father, Kabir is coaxed into taking a road trip with Dhungya and Dhairya. Will the journey be successful?
Two estranged, street-fighting brothers square off against each other in a mixed martial arts tournament.

Mumbai Saga is the story of Amartya Rao who takes on the exploitative high and the mighty head-on, snatching his legitimate place under the sun. While on the face of it, Mumbai Saga is the story of the duel between Amartya Rao and Senior Inspector Vijay Sawarkar, it also is the story of hopes, aspirations, friendships and betrayals in the backdrop of early 90s.
A pilot's flight takes a stirring and mysterious trajectory after taking off from an international destination.

Three criminals, a runaway girl and her three best friends, an aspiring director and a star actor cross paths due to an incident. Will they come off better for it or worse? "Velle" depicts the journey of individuals or the common men, who inevitably find themselves amidst the chaos of life, only to realise that in the end everything falls into place - it all makes sense.

The extraordinary story of Shakuntala Devi, the world-renowned mathematician who lived her life on her own terms. While the film pays tribute to her genius as a mathematician, it also humanizes her as a woman and mother, in trying to capture her indomitable spirit. Told through the lens of her relationship with her daughter Anu, the film highlights their very different struggles and aspirations.

B. G. Sharma is a 58 year old widower, living a mundane life that comes to a standstill when his company lays him off. Sharma struggles to cope with his forced retirement and keeps finding ways to stay relevant, but fails. Until, he comes into contact with a bunch of merry women. They rekindle in Sharma, a passion for cooking and chutzpah in general, that help him find his true calling in life.
A jaded forest officer (Vidya Balan) leads a team of trackers and locals intending to capture an unsettled tigress, while battling intense obstacles and pressures, both natural and man-made.

Sattu is a good hearted but good for nothing LLB fail guy who dreams of marrying the IT girl of Ahmedabad Katha, a girl way out of his league. However fate has other plans and Katha and he end up getting married, much to Katha’s dismay. From here on starts Sattu’s tryst to make his wife fall in love with him and how while doing so, he ends up discovering himself and proves to be a worthy husband!

We all revere Tanaji Malusare for the enormous courage he displayed during the battle of Sinhagad, and his ultimate sacrifice for the great cause of Swarajya. However, this grand battle was only a small part of the achievements of Subhedar Tanaji Malusare, a commander in the service of the great king Shivaji. This is his story.
A smart, quirky, geeky woman is a magnet for trouble. That's exactly what makes a struggling businessman fall for his fiancee's sister, but with so many hurdles, their love seems set for disaster.
A loveable, rooted, desi, punjabi young man, who's a single father with a seven year old boy attempts to find love again.
Watch Rani and Nikko, fight the age-old patriarchal traditions and make way for all the women to attend wedding processions! Will this sister duo succeed in bringing about the change?

This is the story of two sisters Roop Kaur & Basant Kaur who are born in Zimidaar's family. After Bhagel Singh listens to both sisters singing, he seeks permission from their father to get them to sing for his company. He agrees on the condition that their identity should remain hidden.
Two men in the Pudukottai district experience difficulties when they realise they have different interpretations of the law.

Prabhu leads a happy life with his family until a vacation changes their life. A traumatic past finds its way back to him, which forces him to reconnect with his brother Kathir, whose darkness Prabhu was not able to handle in the past. Now Prabhu, the clueless, decides to go against all odds to save his only daughter from the clutches of evil, for which he is being tested to his limits.
Aspiring hotelier Nalan gets embroiled in mysterious happenings at his restaurant. He delves deeper not knowing the ghost reigns over the kitchen!
A young man named Pulikkuthi Pandi fights injustice while trying to woo a beautiful woman. However, problems arise when he locks horns with a powerful individual.

968 AD. The Pandyan assassins gather once again to destroy the Chola dynasty. Now the mighty Chola princes must fight the Pandyas, the Rashtrakutas and other Chola enemies who have joined forces. Also, at play are the rumours of Ponniyin Selvan’s death at sea, the powerful Pazhuvettarayar’s betrayal, and the tragic destiny of Aditha Karikalan, whose heart was long lost to the vengeful Nandini.

Raame Aandalum Raavane Aandalum also known as RARA talks about a village, which is breaking news in all television channels in India but the people of the village don’t have electricity to watch Television.

A 15-year-old boy living in Veeranor, gets struck by lightning and goes into a short coma. After recovery, he gradually realizes that he has superpowers of lightning and mind control. With the help of his powers and demi God "VEERAN" how he handled the villain and avoid the major electirc blast.

With the impact on interpersonal relationships when two families in a small town choose to indulge in a multi-generational legal battle as it’s primary plot line, the story of ‘Anni Manchi Sakunamule’ is set in a fictional town of Victoriapuram and filmed in the scenic Nilgiris.

A tribal clan of ayurvedic practitioners built a temple, that gave birth to a town called Dharmasthali, governed by the clan. But Acharya, a comrade, enters the town, witnesses rampant corruption and a powerless clan. Acharya, goes onto mutilate Basava, the man behind the crimes, reveals his bond with Siddha, the clan’s bygone protector and restores the town’s serene identity, guided by the clan.

A hilarious misadventure of three buddies as they travel from Jogipet to Hyderabad in search for king size lives, instead tumble into a series of dangerous events brewing in the city. Jathi Ratnalu is the deadliest comedy you can see.

Balagam is set in a village in Telangana and it revolves around the after effects on a family and its relations, both with the village folks and among themselves, after the jovial patriarch of the family suddenly passes away.
A man seeks to settle the score with a powerful businessman who causes him significant financial loss.
Shakuntala and King Dushyant marry, but Dushyant forgets all about Shakuntala due to a sage's curse.

Sarileru Neekevvaru is the story of Ajay Krishna (Mahesh Babu), a superior Army Major who is a player in handling tough tasks across the border. Soon, Ajay moves to Kurnool on a secret mission and he comes to know about a tiff of a family with the antagonist.

Sarkaru Vaari Paata is a story about Mahi (Mahesh Babu), who believes that financial discipline is a must have quality in everyone. What happens when he encounters Rajendranath who doesn`t respect money. Kalavathi (Keerthy Suresh) is the love interest of Mahi in this action drama.

After receiving the news of the death of his elder brother Subash, who worked for R&AW, Jay sets out on a mission to find out what happened leading him into a bigger conspiracy of a possible nuclear attack threat to the country by an extreme radical dirty scientist.
A couple on the verge of divorce have to stay together during lockdown as a nasty surprise awaits them.

Aaraattu is set in a fictional village called Muthalakotta. The rustic serenity of the place is rattled by the arrival of Neyyattinkara Gopan, who is a rare mix of bravado and comic extravagance. The very purpose of his coming to the village undermines what the people there stand for. But their resistance withers layer by layer as Gopan weaves his spell on them.

A young, free-spirited writer arrives to stay in a desolate mansion, rumoured to be haunted by the apparition of a young woman who committed suicide when she was betrayed in love. Based on Vaikom Muhammed Basheer's timeless classic, this reimagination weaves a spellbinding narrative, blending traditional storytelling with modern filmmaking.

title.en: Marakkar: Lion of the Arabian Sea

overview.en: The movie is a biopic on the real-life character, Kunjali Marakkar who is till date considered one of the greatest naval chiefs of India. An epic tale, set in the late 15th century and early16th century, the film is  based on the fearless seafarer of the Malabar Coast, Kunjali Marakkar.

The family suspense thriller movie is revolving around a midlife woman" Ardra" misunderstood to be possessed, as she undergoes psychological trauma after her early menopause. Dr. Deric enters Aadra's life in a mythbusting way to unveil the truth.

title.de: ผจญภัยล่าขุมทรัพย์หมื่นลี้

overview.en: Joy was sent to Shanghai. There, she met Ricky. They competed to buy a pair of figurines, but Ricky broke it, revealing an ancient treasure map. Ricky wanted to purchase it from Joy, but she refused. Ricky shared a secret: the treasure hinted in the map. Joy agreed, and breaking the figurine, they found another map, missing the final part. Their joint adventure for the treasure began.

overview.de: Having lost love, her job, and her home, Emma had hit rock bottom when she stumbled upon the estate of Chloe, a mysterious heiress. Unexpected happenings lead the two of them to become housemates, and together, they open a fortune-telling shop where troubled souls come searching for answers. The pair soon realize that each client's problem comes with hidden secrets and mysteries.
overview.en: Having lost love, her job, and her home, Emma had hit rock bottom when she stumbled upon the estate of Chloe, a mysterious heiress. Unexpected happenings lead the two of them to become housemates, and together, they open a fortune-telling shop where troubled souls come searching for answers. The pair soon realize that each client's problem comes with hidden secrets and mysteries.

title.de: しあわせは食べて寝て待て
title.en: Happiness Comes from Eating, Sleeping and Waiting

overview.en: Led by Nao Matsushita, Fumino Kimura, Aimi Higa, Mary Jun Takahashi, and Koyuki, "SKY Castle" follows the lives of five elite women in the luxurious SKY Castle neighborhood. Underneath this glamorous setting lies a battlefield of vanity, pride, and love-hate. This is about the slugfest of wealthy and stunning wives with ambitions... and dark secrets. (C)SLL/tv asahi. All rights reserved.

title.de: テミスの不確かな法廷

overview.en: Is she an angel or a devil? Mitsuko is a total coordinator, polishing and transforming a client's visual and inner self. She will make her clients successful by any means necessary. Her next client is Natsu Imai, a perpetually unlucky single mother. Their goal is to turn Natsu into the next CEO of a large family-run company. Will this be a success story, or a raging suspense drama? ©NIPPON TV

title.de: ミッドナイトタクシー

overview.en: [With ENG Subtitles] A bold declaration. A dream unshaken. From a small island to the heart of Tokyo, Sakura’s ten-year journey in her chosen profession is one of resilience, inspiring those around her and proving that passion can break down any wall.

title.de: 愛してたって、秘密はある。

overview.en: [With ENG Subtitles] Some secrets are so bad that they cannot be revealed to one's lover. Rei was in his last year of middle school when he killed his father to protect his mother from domestic violence.
Kazusa finds a mysterious white object in a scene while she is editing a horror film. Her boss orders the cut be omitted. Tragedy strikes that night.©2022 ︎north cky

title.de: Clashing Through the Snow – Ein Weihnachts-Roadtrip

overview.de: From ist das Mysterium einer albtraumhaften Stadt, die alle gefangen hält, die sie betreten. Die unfreiwilligen Einwohner müssen einen Sinn für Normalität bewahren, einen Ausweg suchen und die Bedrohungen des umgebenden Waldes überleben.
overview.en: The closer the residents of town get to the answers they seek, the more terrifying their search becomes. Who is the Man in Yellow, and what does he want? Will Jade and Tabitha's revelation be the key to finally going home?

Grammy nominated comedian Nate Bargatze delivers his family friendly take on a variety of topics including disadvantages of being the first born, the challenges of playing golf with your wife, and what happens when a bald eagle touches your head.

overview.de: Ein Junge bricht bei seinem neuen Haustier versehentlich drei wichtige Regeln und setzt dadurch eine Horde von übelwollenden, spitzbübischen Monstern in einer Kleinstadt frei.
overview.en: Some furry and not-so-cute little creatures besiege a small town after a young man ignores the warnings of a wise elder regarding their care and feeding.

overview.de: Für Peter Parker beginnt ein neuer Lebensabschnitt. Der Vollzeitkampf gegen das Verbrechen als Spider-Man, sowie der Druck, mitanzusehen, wie seine alten Freunde ohne ihn weitermachen, lösen in Peter eine Veränderung aus. Doch diese Verwandlung könnte das Einzige sein, was eine neue, unsichtbare Bedrohung für die Stadt und die Menschen, die er liebt, aufhalten kann.
overview.en: A powerful change in Peter may be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city.

title.de: Toos: De van der valk ontvoering
title.en: Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping

overview.en: A group of queer best friends gather in Fire Island Pines for their annual week of love and laughter, but a sudden change of events might make this their last summer in gay paradise.

overview.de: Die Welt brauchte einen Helden - sie bekam einen Igel. Unfassbar schnell rast Sonic dahin, um die Erde vor der Herrschaft des bösen Genies Dr. Robotnik zu retten. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz und James Marsden in einem Abenteuer für die ganze Familie.
overview.en: Sonic races across the globe to stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination.
